items.en: Sushi bowl — chopped tuna with takuan pickle under a wasabi mayonnaise
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ワサビマヨは卵、寿司飯や添え醤油に小麦の可能性。Wasabi mayo means egg; the rice seasoning and any soy served alongside are the wheat risk — ask.

items.ja: キーマカレー（辛さレベル1〜10）
items.en: Keema curry, with the heat set anywhere from 1 to 10 — say a number when you order
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: スパイスから作るキーマならルウ不要だが、店は原材料を公開していない。A from-scratch keema needs no wheat roux, unlike a Japanese curry — but this shop publishes no ingredients, so ask whether flour or a commercial roux goes in. Minced meat.

items.ja: グリーンサラダボウル（おにぎり or トースト付）
items.romaji: green salad bowl (onigiri or toast tsuki)
items.en: Green salad bowl, served with either a rice ball or toast — choose the onigiri and the plate changes character entirely
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: トーストは小麦。おにぎりを選べば小麦回避の可能性があるが、ドレッシングと具材は未公開。Pick toast and it is wheat; pick the onigiri and it may not be — but the dressing and the rice-ball filling are not published, so ask. Dressings commonly carry soy sauce or dairy.

items.en: Omurice — the shop's board carries a handwritten apology that ingredient costs forced the price up
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: 店の手書き注記：「材料が高くなっている為、値上げしました。すみません」。ケチャップライスに使うウスターソースやデミグラスは小麦、卵あり。Omurice sauces (Worcester, demi-glace, or a soy-spiked ketchup rice) are wheat-based, and the dish is wrapped in egg.

items.ja: なんでもリクエストオーダー（パスタ・ドリアなどなど）
items.en: Request anything — the board invites you to ask for pasta, doria or whatever else, at market price. Currently marked 'coming soon'
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ボードに「coming soon」の付箋あり。パスタ・ドリアはいずれも小麦。The board has a 'coming soon' sticker over part of this line, so it may not be running. Pasta and doria are both wheat — but a request-anything policy is exactly the opening a restricted diet needs. Worth asking in person.

items.ja: 煮込みハンバーグ ビーフシチュー
items.en: Hamburg steak simmered in beef stew. Currently marked 'coming soon' on the board
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ボードに「coming soon」の付箋あり。デミグラス／シチューのルウは小麦、ハンバーグのつなぎはパン粉。Marked coming soon. Stew roux is wheat and the patty binder is panko.

items.ja: ランチドリンク（ICEコーヒー／ICEティー）
items.en: Add an iced coffee or iced tea to any lunch
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: ブラックであれば植物性。Plant-only if taken black. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.en: Take any lunch away as a bento and it is ¥200 cheaper
items.section: Lunch（スープ・小鉢・デザート付き）
items.note: 同じ料理の持ち帰り。Same dishes, boxed. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 竹炭ドリップコーヒー
items.en: Bamboo-charcoal drip coffee — the café's signature, filtered through bamboo charcoal
items.note: コーヒーのみ。Black coffee. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.en: Bamboo-charcoal americano
items.note: Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Café latte
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy milk; plant-milk substitution is not advertised — ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: カプチーノ（ストレート／キャラメル／チョコ）
items.en: Cappuccino — plain, caramel or chocolate
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Nilgiri black tea from southern India
items.note: 茶葉のみ。Straight tea leaf — not a barley tea. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: コールドブリューコーヒー
items.en: Cold brew coffee
items.note: No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.en: Iced latte
items.note: 牛乳使用。Dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: クリームラテ（ストレート／キャラメル／チョコ）
items.en: Cream latte — plain, caramel or chocolate
items.note: 生クリーム・牛乳。Cream and dairy milk. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: ニルギリ産アイスティー
items.en: Iced Nilgiri tea
items.note: Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Iced chai
items.note: チャイは牛乳ベース。Chai is milk-based here; plant-milk is not advertised. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 本日のフルーツスムージー
items.en: The day's fruit smoothie
items.note: ヨーグルトや牛乳が入る場合あり、内容は日替わり。Smoothies often carry yoghurt or milk and the fruit changes daily — ask. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: 本日のフルーツソーダ
items.en: The day's fruit soda
items.note: ボードに価格の記載なし（スムージーの¥700と並記されているが本品の価格線は空欄）。The board lists this line without its own price — the ¥700 sits against the smoothie above it. Read the board rather than assume the same figure. No wheat route in a soft drink.

tokyo_hayashi.price_note: Read from photographs of the shop's own bilingual window board and its ticket machine, both dated 2026-06 — the machine has exactly three live buttons and they match the board, so this is the whole menu. Cash only. Open 11:30–15:30 and closes the moment the soup runs out; shut Wednesdays and Sundays. The window also asks that children of primary-school age and under not be brought in. A Tabelog user card updated 2025-11 adds the off-menu 塩らーめん.

items.en: The bowl this counter has been famous for since the 1970s and which has made the Tabelog ramen Hyakumeiten list every year since 2017: a dark soy broth built on fish, dried shrimp, chicken and pork, with a heap of chopped raw onion on top. The onion is the point — do not push it aside
items.note: 店自らが掲示：「当店では魚介類・エビ・鶏肉・豚肉・醤油等の材料を使用しています」。醤油＝小麦、中華麺＝小麦。The shop posts its own allergy notice in the window naming fish, shrimp, chicken, pork and soy sauce — soy sauce means wheat, and the noodles are wheat too. That notice is unusually forthcoming for a ramen counter and is worth reading if you have a shellfish allergy.

items.en: The same bowl with a marinated soft-boiled egg
items.note: 麺・スープ・味玉の漬け地すべて醤油＝小麦。Wheat in the noodles, the broth and the egg marinade.

items.ja: 焼豚らーめん（味玉付き）
items.en: The bowl piled with chashu pork, marinated egg included
items.note: 焼豚の煮汁も醤油。The chashu braise is soy as well.

items.ja: 塩らーめん（裏メニュー）
items.en: The off-menu salt version. It is not on the ticket machine or the board: buy a normal ¥1,000 ticket, and when you hand it over say 塩味で (shio-aji de). No extra charge
items.note: 食べログの利用者登録メニュー（更新日2025/11/24）による裏メニュー。塩でも麺は小麦、スープのベースは同じ魚介・鶏・豚。Recorded on the shop's Tabelog page by a user (updated 2025-11-24), not by the shop — but the ordering instruction is specific enough to be worth carrying. Salt tare instead of soy, but the noodles are still wheat and the stock is the same fish-chicken-pork base.

tokyo_miyazaki_fu_do_quwanne.price_note: The lunch teishoku, the add-ons, the desserts and the soft drinks are read from photographs of the shop's own bound menu book dated 2026-07. The evening à la carte and courses come from the shop's Tabelog listing, updated 2026-08-03 — very recent, and written in the shop's own promotional voice, but registered rather than owner-verified, so treat those figures as strong rather than certain. Tax included. The restaurant is the 2F of 新宿みやざき館 KONNE, Miyazaki Prefecture's Tokyo showcase on Shinjuku Southern Terrace — the shop notes that supply may force substitutions and that not every ingredient is from Miyazaki. Open 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00).

items.en: Miyazaki's defining dish and the reason to come at lunch: cold miso-and-grilled-aji soup, thick with sesame, tofu, shiso, myoga and cucumber, poured over rice. Set includes two sashimi, a mini chicken nanban, rice, miso soup and pickles. Rice size S/M/L, large +¥50
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 冷や汁は麦味噌を使うのが宮崎の伝統で、麦＝グルテン。だしは鰹・鯵。加えてチキン南蛮は小麦衣。Hiyajiru in Miyazaki is traditionally made with 麦味噌 (barley miso), and barley is gluten — this is exactly the trap the dish sets. The stock is grilled horse mackerel and bonito, and the set includes a wheat-battered chicken nanban. Ask which miso if it matters.

items.en: Bonito from Nichinan, cured in soy and sesame, eaten first straight over rice and then as chazuke with the dashi poured on — the fishing-town way. With a small side, a katsuobushi salad, rice and miso soup
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦、出汁茶漬けの出汁も醤油系。The cure is soy sauce and the pouring dashi is soy-seasoned.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼定食
items.romaji: sumi kaoru Miyazaki jitokko oyakodon teishoku
items.en: Oyakodon made with charcoal-grilled Miyazaki jitokko chicken, so the egg-and-chicken bowl carries smoke through it
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 親子丼の割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Oyakodon simmering liquid is soy and mirin; contains egg. The shop notes the egg is not necessarily a jidori egg.

items.en: Upsize the rice on any teishoku
items.section: くわんねの定食 Lunch teishoku (2026-07 book)
items.note: 白米のみ。Plain rice.

items.ja: ちょいたし：刺身2種盛り
items.en: Lunch add-on: two kinds of sashimi, with the house sweet-soy sauce made from Miyazaki soy
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油で作る自家製醤油餡＝小麦。The house sauce is built on Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt if you need to avoid it; the fish itself is clean.

items.ja: ちょいたし：若鶏ミニチキン南蛮
items.en: Lunch add-on: a small chicken nanban — fried chicken in sweet vinegar under tartare sauce. Miyazaki invented the dish and this shop won gold in the national karaage grand prix for it
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油ベース、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy-based sweet vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare. Nothing about chicken nanban is gluten-free.

items.ja: ちょいたし：みやざき地頭鶏むね身たたき
items.en: Lunch add-on: jitokko chicken breast seared outside, raw inside, sliced thin. The shop describes it as bouncy and full-flavoured
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: つけダレの内容は未表示。The dipping sauce is not itemised on the book — ask, since ponzu and soy are the usual accompaniments. Note this is raw chicken, served deliberately.

items.ja: ちょいたし：蔵の厚焼き卵焼き
items.en: Lunch add-on: the thick rolled omelette the shop compares to a custard pudding
items.section: ちょいたし5選 Lunch add-ons (2026-07 book)
items.note: 写真では価格欄が読み取れず。À la carte it is ¥600; the add-on price was not legible in the photographed page, so it is left empty rather than guessed. Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏の炭火焼き
items.en: The dish Miyazaki is known for nationally: jitokko chicken — a slow-grown native breed raised four to five months — charred hard over charcoal so it comes out black, smoky and genuinely chewy
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 炭火焼きは塩のみの場合と醤油ダレの場合がある。Charcoal-grilled jitokko is often salt-only, which would make it one of the safer dishes here — but the shop does not say, and柚子胡椒 and soy are the usual partners. Ask for 塩のみ.

items.en: Charcoal-grilled Miyazaki beef — the brand requires Japanese Black cattle raised in the prefecture and graded 4 or above
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: つけダレ・味付けは未表示。Seasoning not published — ask for salt only.

items.en: Charcoal-grilled 'sweet-potato pork' — pigs fed a blend of sweet potato and barley, which the shop says gives soft meat and sweet fat
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 餌に大麦を使うが、飼料の麦が肉のグルテンになるわけではない。味付けが未表示のため要確認。The barley is in the feed, not the meat — feed does not transfer gluten. The unknown is the seasoning, which is not published. Ask.

items.en: Gold medallist in the 11th national Karaage Grand Prix, chicken-nanban division: the young-chicken nanban served with a shiitake nanban alongside
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 衣は小麦・卵、甘酢は醤油、タルタルは卵・乳。Wheat batter, soy sweet-vinegar, egg-and-dairy tartare — and the shiitake half is battered the same way, so it is not the vegetarian escape it looks like.

items.en: Sashimi of the day's fish — priced per person, minimum two
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎の甘口醤油（マルタニ醤油）を使用＝小麦。Served with Miyazaki's characteristically sweet soy sauce — wheat. Ask for salt and wasabi.

items.ja: 宮崎県産鮮魚のなめろう
items.en: Namero — fish chopped on the board together with miso and aromatics until it turns into a paste. The shop hides yuzu-kosho in theirs
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌の産地であり、なめろうの味噌が麦味噌なら大麦＝グルテン。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, and if the miso in this namero is 麦味噌 it carries gluten. Ask which miso — this is not a paranoid question in this prefecture.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入りフランク（一個）
items.en: A frankfurter packed with jitokko chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: ソーセージの結着材に小麦を使う場合がある。Sausage binders often carry wheat — ask.

items.en: Spring rolls of chicken and mentaiko with melting cheese and shiso
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 春巻きの皮は小麦、明太子の調味液にも醤油、チーズは乳。Spring-roll wrappers are wheat; mentaiko cure carries soy; cheese is dairy.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏砂肝コンフィ
items.en: Jitokko gizzards confited in jitokko chicken fat — chicken cooked in chicken
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 味付けは未公開。Seasoning not published — a salt-and-fat confit could be wheat-free but ask.

items.ja: みやざき地頭鶏入り梅水晶
items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage in plum paste, made here with jitokko chicken through it. Crunchy, sour, built for shochu
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 梅水晶の調味に醤油・みりんを使うことが多い。Usually seasoned with soy and mirin — ask.

items.ja: クリームチーズの甘醤油漬け
items.en: Cream cheese steeped in Marutani soy sauce — Miyazaki's sweet soy — until the flavour goes all the way through
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 醤油漬け＝小麦、チーズ＝乳。Soy-cured, so wheat, and dairy.

items.ja: 蔵の厚焼き 卵焼き
items.en: Thick rolled omelette with, the shop says, the mouthfeel of a custard pudding
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: だし巻きの出汁・調味に醤油を使うのが一般的。Rolled omelette is normally seasoned with dashi and soy — ask. Egg.

items.en: Obiten — not tempura in the usual sense but a Nichinan speciality going back centuries: fish paste blended with tofu and brown sugar, then deep-fried into a sweet, dense cake
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: すり身のつなぎに小麦粉、味付けに醤油、共用の揚げ油。Fish-paste cakes are bound with wheat flour, seasoned with soy and fried in a shared fryer.

items.ja: マキシマムポテトフライ
items.en: Chips dusted with Maximum — the all-purpose spice mix Miyazaki households put on everything
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 共用フライヤーで唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油を使う。マキシマムの原材料にも要確認。The fryer is shared with wheat-battered karaage and obiten, so cross-contact is certain. Check the Maximum spice blend too.

items.en: Assorted pickles
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 漬物の漬け床に醤油・鰹だしを使うものがある。Some pickles are steeped in soy or bonito dashi — ask which ones are on the plate.

items.ja: なまり節のシーザーサラダ
items.en: Caesar salad with namaribushi — half-dried steamed bonito, flaked over the leaves
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: シーザードレッシングはアンチョビ・卵・チーズ、クルトンは小麦。Caesar dressing means anchovy, egg and cheese, and croutons are wheat.

items.en: Deep-fried mehikari — the small green-eyed deep-sea fish landed off Nobeoka, eaten whole
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 唐揚げの衣は小麦粉・片栗粉、下味に醤油。Karaage coating is wheat and potato starch with a soy marinade.

items.en: The cold miso soup over rice, offered as the finisher to a course or an à la carte evening
items.note: 宮崎の冷や汁は麦味噌が伝統＝大麦。焼き鯵・鰹だしも入る。Miyazaki hiyajiru is traditionally barley miso — gluten — plus grilled aji and bonito stock.

items.en: The soy-cured bonito over rice, as an evening finisher
items.note: 漬け地は醤油＝小麦。Soy cure.

items.ja: “炭薫る”みやざき地頭鶏親子丼
items.en: The charcoal-grilled jitokko oyakodon, as an evening finisher
items.note: 割下は醤油・味醂＝小麦、卵あり。Soy-and-mirin base, egg.

items.en: The Miyazaki feast tray — the shop's set-piece plate, marked as recommended
items.section: アラカルト À la carte (evening)
items.note: 構成品は未公開だが、南蛮・冷や汁・炭火焼きなど小麦を含む定番が入る想定。Contents not itemised; expect it to include the nanban and hiyajiru, both of which carry wheat.

items.ja: ご飯セット（ご飯とお味噌汁）
items.en: Rice and miso soup
items.note: 宮崎は麦味噌文化圏、味噌の種類を要確認。だしは鰹。Miyazaki is barley-miso country, so ask which miso; the dashi will be bonito either way.

items.en: Soy-sauce ice cream made with Marutani, Miyazaki's sweet soy — savoury-sweet and much better than it sounds
items.note: 醤油＝小麦、アイス＝乳。Soy sauce means wheat; ice cream means dairy.

items.ja: 宮崎県産フローズンカットマンゴー
items.en: Frozen Miyazaki mango, cut — the prefecture's most famous fruit
items.note: 冷凍したマンゴー果肉のみ、加工調味なし。Nothing but frozen mango flesh — no wheat, no dairy, no additives. The one dessert here that clears both diets.

items.ja: チーズ饅頭にアイスを添えて
items.romaji: cheese manju ni ice wo soete
items.en: Miyazaki's own confection: a short pastry shell around cream cheese, served here warm with ice cream. With a teishoku, +¥550
items.note: 饅頭の皮は小麦粉、中はクリームチーズ、アイスは乳。The shell is wheat pastry, the filling is cream cheese and the ice cream is dairy.

items.ja: マンゴーソーダ（宮崎県産マンゴー果肉入り）
items.en: Mango soda with pieces of Miyazaki mango in it. With a teishoku, +¥660
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 果肉と炭酸。Fruit and carbonation. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 平兵衛酢はちみつソーダ
items.en: Soda made with heibeizu — a rare citrus grown almost nowhere but Miyazaki — and honey. Gently sour. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: はちみつ使用のためヴィーガン不可。Contains honey, so not vegan. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.en: Soda made with hyuganatsu, the Miyazaki citrus eaten with its white pith on — the shop's own note explains that is the trick to it
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 柑橘と炭酸。Citrus and soda. No wheat route in a soft drink.

items.ja: 愛のスコール（ご当地ドリンク）
items.en: Squall — the milky carbonated soft drink invented in Miyazaki in 1971 and still made by Nanyo Foods. Local to the point of being a mascot. With a teishoku, +¥330
items.section: ソフトドリンク Soft drinks (2026-07 book)
items.note: 乳性炭酸飲料のため乳成分あり。A milk-type carbonated drink — contains dairy. Gluten status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.ja: だれやみコース（当日可）
items.en: Four courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, and a Miyazaki hassun tray. 'Dareyami' is the local word for the evening drink that stops you being tired. Bookable same day
items.note: 刺身の甘口醤油、八寸の煮物など醤油多用。Soy sauce runs through the sashimi and the hassun tray. Ask well in advance for a restricted diet.

items.ja: くわんね地鶏コース（当日可）
items.en: Eight courses: seasonal starters, sashimi of the day, a small hotpot, the charcoal-grilled jitokko, a palate cleanser, a Miyazaki hassun tray, then either katsuo-meshi or hiyajiru to finish, and dessert. 'Quwanne' is Miyazaki dialect for 'eat up'. Bookable same day
items.note: 〆に冷や汁を選ぶと麦味噌の可能性、小鍋・八寸にも醤油。If you pick hiyajiru as the finisher you may be getting barley miso; the hotpot and hassun are soy-seasoned regardless.

tokyo_imoya.price_note: Set prices come from the shop's own handwritten price-rise notice, dated 令和8年1月22日 (2026-01-22) and signed いもや: from 2026-03-02 えび定食 ¥1,200→¥1,400 and 天ぷら定食 ¥1,000→¥1,100, with 「他につきましては現行のまま」 (everything else unchanged). The à-la-carte prices are read off the shop's own hanging wooden tags photographed 2026-03. A Tabelog visitor confirmed ¥1,400 / ¥1,100 as at 2026-08-18. House rules on the blackboard: 「お食事中の会話・スマホはご遠慮下さい」 (no chatting or phones while eating) and 「追加はご注文時にお願いします」 (order any extras with your first order). Seven counter seats, cash only, lunch only 11:30–13:50 and they close when the day's ingredients run out; a 2026-03 notice announced a temporary closure from 3/11 but a 2026-06 door notice shows normal service resumed. Prices approximate — may change.

items.en: Yū or Yoroshiku Semman Arubeshi rice shōchū
items.note: 米焼酎は米と米麹のみ。麦・小麦を使わない。焼酎の中でグルテン回避に最も安全な選択肢。

items.en: Onibi roasted-sweet-potato shōchū
items.note: 焼き芋仕込み。麹の原料を要確認。

items.en: Kikusui dry sake, Niigata, 200ml
items.note: 等級表示なし。本醸造なら醸造アルコール添加。要確認。

items.ja: 沢の鶴 純米原酒（兵庫・200ml）
items.en: Sawanotsuru junmai genshu, Hyōgo, 200ml
items.note: 純米原酒＝米と米麹と水のみ、加水なし。麦・小麦不使用。

items.ja: 銀盤 純米大吟醸（富山・200ml）
items.en: Ginban junmai daiginjō, Toyama, 200ml
items.note: 純米大吟醸＝米と米麹と水のみ。

items.en: Cup sake, changing selection including seasonal releases
items.note: おすすめ表示。入荷状況により銘柄が変わるため等級を都度確認。

items.ja: シーバスリーガル ミズナラ
items.en: Chivas Regal Mizunara
items.note: スコッチ＝大麦・穀物。知多・白州各1,650円、響ジャパニーズハーモニー1,870円、山崎12年2,750円。

items.ja: カクテル（カシスソーダ／モスコミュール／ジントニック ほか）
items.en: Cocktails — cassis soda, cassis oolong, peach soda, peach oolong, rum coke, rum on the rocks, gin tonic, bulldog, moscow mule
items.note: 各770円。ジン・ウォッカ・ラムの原料は蒸留されるが、銘柄を気にする人は確認を。

items.ja: テキーラ（クエルボ ゴールド／ポルフィディオ スーパーハリスコ）
items.en: Tequila — Cuervo Gold, or Porfidio Super Jalisco (¥1,650)
items.note: テキーラはブルーアガベが原料で穀物を一切使わない。ポルフィディオ スーパーハリスコは1,650円。

tokyo_with_green_shinjuku_sanc.price_note: Prices and compositions from WithGreen's own national menu page; every gluten and dairy call below is read directly off the company's own 28-item allergen chart, PDF dated 2026-07-01. Chain-wide pricing — the Shinjuku Sanchome branch (新宿3-1-17 山本ビル 1F, A2 exit 1 min, 16 seats, 11:00–21:00, eat-in L.O. 20:30) does not publish its own prices. Salads come in S/M/L. The chart's own caveat matters: toppings are assembled in a shared bowl line, so the company explicitly does not guarantee against cross-contact, and changing toppings voids the listed allergens. Prices approximate — may change.

items.en: The whole day's vegetables in one bowl — 350g of them, no protein at all: carrot, daikon, tomato, red cabbage, cucumber, corn, grilled potato and onion. Recommended dressing: lemon. 118kcal for M without dressing
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 会社の公式アレルギー表（2026/7/1）でこのサラダ（ドレッシング抜き）は28品目すべて該当なし。レモンドレッシングも同様に該当なし。WithGreen's own allergen chart shows this salad, dressing excluded, with NOT ONE of the 28 listed allergens — no wheat, no dairy, no egg — and the recommended lemon dressing is likewise clear across the board. Pair those two and it is the single most reliably gluten-free and vegan bowl in this shard. The company still warns of topping cross-contact on the line.

items.ja: 甘辛きんぴらごぼうと玄米のサラダ
items.romaji: amakara kinpira gobo to genmai no salad
items.en: A Japanese-leaning bowl: sweet-savoury burdock kinpira, sweet potato, cucumber and brown rice. Recommended dressing: ginger. The cheapest salad on the card
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦●（きんぴらごぼうが小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のジンジャードレッシングも卵●小麦●。The chart flags 小麦 on this salad through the kinpira itself, and the recommended ginger dressing carries wheat AND egg. Swap to lemon dressing and it is still wheat via the burdock. Otherwise plant-only — ask about the kinpira seasoning for vegan.

items.ja: 蒸し鶏とりんごのサラダ
items.en: Sweet vegetables throughout — sweet potato, apple, corn, carrot — with steamed chicken. The shop suggests it for a light meal or for children. Recommended dressing: citrus
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表でこのサラダは乳●のみ、小麦は該当なし。ただし推奨の柑橘ドレッシングは小麦●。The chart shows the salad itself carries dairy but NOT wheat — the wheat comes in with the recommended citrus dressing, which is flagged 小麦. Order it with lemon or ごま塩 dressing (both wheat-free on the chart) and you have a chicken salad without wheat. Ask about the dairy in the steamed chicken.

items.ja: 砂肝ともやしナムルのサラダ
items.romaji: sunagimo to moyashi namul no salad
items.en: Gizzard in a salad sounds odd and the shop says so on its own menu — it is one of the regulars' favourites. Bean-sprout namul, carrot, brown rice, daikon and chicken gizzard. Recommended dressing: sesame salt
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦●（砂肝が小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のごま塩ドレッシングは小麦該当なし。The chart flags 小麦 on the gizzard itself, so the salad is wheat regardless of dressing — though the recommended sesame-salt dressing is one of the clean ones.

items.ja: 特製たれの棒棒鶏サラダ
items.romaji: tokusei tare no bang bang ji salad
items.en: Bang bang ji — poached chicken in a soy-sesame sauce — with carrot, bean-sprout namul, cucumber and tofu. The shop notes it is popular with people who train. Recommended dressing: onion
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●、原材料の一部にはちみつを含む。The chart flags both dairy and wheat — the bang bang ji sauce is soy-based, as the shop's own description says — and notes honey in the ingredients, so not vegan on two counts. The recommended onion dressing is also flagged 小麦.

items.ja: レッドチリチキンのコブサラダ
items.romaji: red chili chicken no Cobb salad
items.en: Cobb salad with spicy red-chilli chicken and boiled egg, red cabbage, tomato and cucumber — the most protein-dense bowl at 24.4g. Recommended dressing: Mexican
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で卵●乳●小麦●。推奨のメキシカンドレッシングは卵●乳●だが小麦は該当なし。Chart flags egg, dairy and wheat in the salad. The Mexican dressing is one of the wheat-free ones, but the chicken itself carries the wheat.

items.ja: キーマカレーとじゃがいもグリルのサラダ
items.romaji: keema curry to jagaimo grill no salad
items.en: Spiced keema curry over salad with apple, grilled potato, red cabbage and brown rice — the biggest bowl on the card at 311kcal. Recommended dressing: honey milk
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●、はちみつを含む。The chart flags dairy and wheat in the keema and notes honey. The recommended honey-milk dressing adds egg and dairy but no wheat.

items.ja: たっぷりスモークチキンのシーザーサラダ
items.romaji: tappuri smoked chicken no Caesar salad
items.en: Plenty of smoked chicken with corn, grilled potato, carrot and shio-koji shimeji mushrooms. Recommended dressing: Caesar
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 重要：公式アレルギー表ではサラダ本体（ドレッシング抜き）に小麦の表示がない一方、シーザードレッシング自体は卵●乳●小麦●落花生●。Worth knowing: on the chart the salad WITHOUT dressing shows no wheat at all — it is the Caesar dressing that carries wheat, egg, dairy and peanut. Order it with lemon or ごま塩 instead and the wheat goes away. Ask, because the recommendation is the problem, not the bowl.

items.ja: 低温ローストポークのごちそうサラダ
items.romaji: teion roast pork no gochiso salad
items.en: Sous-vide domestic pork leg with carrot, brown rice, apple and shio-koji shimeji — the shop pitches it at people who want to eat actual meat. Recommended dressing: ginger
items.section: スタンダードサラダ Standard salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で卵●乳●小麦●、はちみつを含む。ローストポークのたれも小麦●。Chart flags egg, dairy and wheat in the salad, and separately flags wheat in the roast-pork sauce. Honey too.

items.ja: BBQチキンと彩り夏野菜のサラダ
items.romaji: BBQ chicken to irodori natsu-yasai no salad
items.en: Seasonal (summer): BBQ chicken with marinated onion, tomato, cucumber, red cabbage and corn. Recommended dressing: honey mustard
items.section: 季節限定サラダ Seasonal salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●（BBQチキンが原因）。推奨のハニーマスタードドレッシングは小麦該当なしだが、はちみつを含む。The chart flags dairy and wheat in the BBQ chicken. The honey-mustard dressing is wheat-free but contains honey.

items.ja: 肉味噌たっぷり麻婆春雨と夏採れズッキーニのサラダ
items.romaji: nikumiso tappuri mabo harusame to natsu-dore zucchini no salad
items.en: Seasonal (summer): mapo glass noodles heavy with meat miso, plus sweet-vinegared daikon, zucchini, carrot, tomato and tofu. Recommended dressing: creamy sesame
items.section: 季節限定サラダ Seasonal salads
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●落花生●。麻婆春雨そのものが小麦、大根の甘酢漬けも小麦。Chart flags dairy, wheat AND peanut. Two separate components carry wheat here — the mapo glass noodles and the sweet-vinegared daikon — so no dressing swap saves it.

items.ja: 自由に選べるカスタムサラダ
items.en: Build your own: pick five standard toppings and a dressing, add more for a fee. This is the route to a bowl that fits a restriction, because the company publishes an allergen line for every single topping
items.section: カスタムサラダ Custom salad
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で小麦「該当なし」のトッピング：人参・大根・オニオン・紫キャベツ・トマト・きゅうり・りんご・コーン・さつまいも・豆腐・もやしナムル・玄米・じゃがいもグリル・塩麹しめじ・ゆで卵（卵）・スモークチキン・オニオンマリネ・ズッキーニ。小麦●のトッピング：きんぴらごぼう・砂肝・棒棒鶏・レッドチリチキン・キーマカレー・ローストポーク（とそのたれ）・BBQチキン・麻婆春雨・大根の甘酢漬け・パン。蒸し鶏は乳●のみで小麦なし。The chart clears every plain vegetable topping, brown rice, tofu, shio-koji shimeji, grilled potato and — usefully — smoked chicken and steamed chicken of wheat, while flagging 小麦 on every sauce-carrying protein. Build from the cleared list and you get a genuinely wheat-free bowl. The company's own caveat still applies: shared line, cross-contact not guaranteed.

items.ja: トッピング［スタンダード］大根・豆腐・玄米・人参・紫キャベツ・さつまいも・トマト・コーン・きゅうり・りんご・オニオン・もやしナムル
items.en: Standard toppings, any of them: daikon, tofu, brown rice, carrot, red cabbage, sweet potato, tomato, corn, cucumber, apple, onion, bean-sprout namul. Five are included in a custom salad; extras are ¥110 each
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で12品すべて小麦・乳・卵とも「該当なし」（豆腐とりんごとナムルは大豆・りんご・ごまのみ表示）。All twelve are cleared of wheat, dairy and egg on the company's own chart — the only flags are soy (tofu, namul), sesame (namul) and apple. The brown rice is stated to be domestic.

items.ja: トッピング［プレミアム］じゃがいもグリル ¥150／塩麹しめじ ¥180／ゆで卵 ¥220／ちょい足し砂肝 ¥220／きんぴらごぼう ¥280／蒸し鶏 ¥370／砂肝 ¥410／レッドチリチキン ¥430／棒棒鶏 ¥440／キーマカレー ¥450／スモークチキン ¥500／ローストポーク ¥640
items.en: Premium toppings, priced individually from grilled potato at ¥150 up to roast pork at ¥640
items.note: 小麦「該当なし」：じゃがいもグリル・塩麹しめじ・ゆで卵（卵●）・スモークチキン・蒸し鶏（乳●）。小麦●：きんぴらごぼう・砂肝・棒棒鶏・レッドチリチキン・キーマカレー・ローストポーク。Read the chart before choosing: grilled potato, shio-koji shimeji, boiled egg, smoked chicken and steamed chicken carry no wheat, while every soy-sauced protein does. Smoked chicken at ¥500 is the wheat-free protein.

items.ja: トッピング［シーズナル］大根の甘酢漬け ¥110／オニオンマリネ ¥130／ズッキーニ ¥150／麻婆春雨 ¥390／BBQチキン ¥460
items.en: Seasonal toppings: sweet-vinegared daikon, marinated onion, zucchini, mapo glass noodles, BBQ chicken
items.note: 小麦「該当なし」：オニオンマリネ・ズッキーニ。小麦●：大根の甘酢漬け・麻婆春雨・BBQチキン。Marinated onion and zucchini are clear; the sweet-vinegared daikon is not — a ¥110 pickle carrying wheat is exactly the sort of thing that catches people out.

items.ja: ドレッシング［さっぱりタイプ］柑橘・ごま塩・オニオン・柚子しょうゆ・レモン・ハニーマスタード
items.en: Light dressings: citrus, sesame salt, onion, yuzu-soy, lemon, honey mustard. Any dressing can be swapped onto any salad at no charge
items.note: 公式アレルギー表：レモン＝28品目すべて該当なし。ごま塩＝ごま・大豆のみ。ハニーマスタード＝はちみつのみ。小麦●：柚子しょうゆ・柑橘・オニオン。Lemon is completely clean on the chart — no allergen at all — and sesame-salt carries only sesame and soy. Yuzu-soy, citrus and onion all carry wheat. Honey mustard is wheat-free but has honey, so not vegan.

items.ja: ドレッシング［クリーミータイプ］ナッツ・ごまクリーミー・バジルチーズ・ハニーミルク・メキシカン・シーザー・ジンジャー
items.en: Creamy dressings: nut, creamy sesame, basil cheese, honey milk, Mexican, Caesar, ginger
items.note: 小麦●：ジンジャー・ごまクリーミー・シーザー・ナッツ。小麦該当なし：バジルチーズ（卵●乳●）・ハニーミルク（卵●乳●）・メキシカン（卵●乳●）。すべて卵か乳を含みヴィーガン不可。Ginger, creamy sesame, Caesar and nut all carry wheat; basil cheese, honey milk and Mexican do not but all carry egg and dairy. None of the creamy dressings is vegan.

items.ja: スープ（ミネストローネ／オニオン／北海道産かぼちゃのポタージュ）
items.romaji: soup — minestrone / onion / Hokkaido kabocha potage
items.en: Soups: minestrone, onion, or Hokkaido pumpkin potage
items.note: 公式アレルギー表に掲載あり（3品とも複数のアレルゲン表示）。価格はメニューページに未掲載。All three appear on the company's allergen chart carrying multiple allergens, so none is a safe default — read the chart or ask. The menu page does not publish soup prices; read the counter board.

items.en: Bread, sold as a side
items.note: 公式アレルギー表で乳●小麦●。Chart flags dairy and wheat. Price not published on the menu page.

tokyo_marugo_s.price_note: Transcribed in full from the shop's own site (marugo-s.com/s/), which publishes the entire card — curry, oysters, food, dessert, tea, coffee, beer, wine, cocktails and highballs. Prices as printed. The shop notes seasonal recommendations rotate. MARUGO S is a counter inside FOOD STADIUM in the yellow building at Tokyo Dome City, 文京区後楽1-3-61, 2F — 24 seats, staff take the order and hand the food over, and a sommelier will pick the wine with you. Open 11:00–23:00, food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30, no closing day. Expect it to be very busy for two hours either side of a Tokyo Dome event.

items.ja: スパイスカレー 1種／2種／3種
items.en: The counter's signature: choose one, two or three of the three spice curries on the plate. The shop describes it as an aroma that hits the nose first and a spice finish that keeps arriving. Add coriander, spiced pickled egg or a large rice for ¥200 each
items.note: スパイスから作るカレーはルウ不使用の場合が多いが、当店は原材料未公開。Spice curries built from whole spices often skip the wheat roux that a Japanese curry needs — so unlike most curry in this shard this one has a real chance. The shop publishes no allergen data, so ask directly about 小麦粉. All three curries contain meat.

items.ja: ラムと青唐辛子のキーマカレー
items.romaji: lamb to aotogarashi no keema curry
items.en: Curry 1 of 3: lamb keema with green chilli
items.note: 原材料未公開。Part of the plate above; no separate price. Ask about wheat.

items.ja: 手羽元とヘーゼルナッツのバターチキン
items.romaji: tebamoto to hazelnut no butter chicken
items.en: Curry 2 of 3: butter chicken made with wings, enriched with hazelnut
items.note: バターチキンは乳製品を含む、ヘーゼルナッツはナッツアレルギー注意。Butter chicken means dairy, and the hazelnut is a tree-nut warning that would be easy to miss from the name.

items.ja: 茨城県産 三右衛門豚のポークビンダル
items.en: Curry 3 of 3: pork vindaloo made with Sanemon pork from Ibaraki — the sour, vinegar-forward Goan curry
items.note: 原材料未公開。Ask about wheat.

items.ja: カレーの追加（追いパクチー／追いスパイス漬け卵／ライス大盛り）
items.en: Curry add-ons: extra coriander, an extra spiced pickled egg, or a large rice
items.note: スパイス漬け卵の漬け地は未公開。Coriander and rice are clean; the pickling liquid on the egg is not published.

items.en: The day's raw oyster, by the piece
items.note: 添えるソース（ミニョネット等）の内容は未公開。The oyster itself is clean; the accompanying sauce is not specified — ask, and take lemon if unsure.

items.en: Two different oysters side by side, to taste against each other
items.note: 同上。Same — ask about the sauce.

items.ja: スパイス漬け卵のポテトサラダ
items.en: Potato salad with the house spiced pickled egg through it
items.note: ポテトサラダはマヨネーズ＝卵、漬け卵の漬け地は未公開。Mayonnaise means egg; the egg pickle's liquid is not published — ask if soy is in it.

items.ja: キャロットラペのシーフードマリネ
items.en: Carrot rapée with marinated seafood
items.note: マリネ液の内容は未公開。Marinade not itemised.

items.ja: ティムールペッパーとカカオニブの悶絶なめらかレバームース
items.romaji: Timur pepper to cacao nib no monzetsu nameraka liver mousse
items.en: 'Agonisingly smooth' chicken-liver mousse with Timur pepper — the Nepalese grapefruit-scented peppercorn — and cacao nibs
items.note: レバームースは通常バター・生クリーム＝乳、付け合わせのパンは小麦。Liver mousse is normally set with butter and cream, i.e. dairy, and if bread or toast comes with it that is wheat — ask whether it is served with anything.

items.ja: 鴨肉と赤玉葱のアチャール
items.en: Duck and red onion achar — the South Asian pickle treatment applied to duck
items.note: アチャールの漬け地は未公開。Pickling liquid not published.

items.ja: スモークサーモンとアボカド、ディルのマリネ
items.romaji: smoked salmon to avocado, dill no marine
items.en: Smoked salmon, avocado and dill, marinated
items.note: マリネ液は未公開。Marinade not published; smoked fish cures sometimes carry malt or soy.

items.ja: 低温調理の鶏むね肉のハム レモンとパセリのチミチュリ
items.romaji: teion chori no torimune-niku no ham, lemon to parsley no chimichurri
items.en: Sous-vide chicken-breast ham under a lemon-and-parsley chimichurri
items.note: チミチュリはオイル・酢・ハーブが基本で小麦不使用のことが多い。Chimichurri is oil, vinegar and herbs, so usually wheat-free — one of the better bets here, but the ham cure is unpublished. Ask.

items.ja: 麻婆青豆 -マーラーグリンピース-
items.en: Mapo green peas in mala numbing-hot spice — a joke on mapo tofu that works. The cheapest thing on the food card
items.note: 麻婆の豆板醤・甜麺醤は小麦を含むのが一般的、通常は豚挽肉入り。Mapo seasonings — doubanjiang and tianmianjiang — are both wheat-fermented as a rule, and mapo dishes normally carry minced pork. Not the vegetarian dish the name suggests.

items.en: French broad beans
items.note: 調理法・味付けは未公開。Preparation not published; broad beans themselves are clean.

items.ja: 甘海老のスパイスフリット
items.en: Sweet shrimp in spiced fritto batter
items.note: フリットの衣は小麦粉が基本、共用フライヤー。Fritto batter is wheat flour, and the fryer is shared with the chips and karaage.

items.ja: ラムのプロシェット 毛沢東風
items.en: Lamb brochette 'Mao Zedong style' — the shop tells you to bury it in Mao spice and says the leftover spice alone works as a snack. One skewer, extras ¥700 each
items.note: 毛沢東スパイスの原材料は未公開、中華スパイスミックスに小麦が入る場合がある。The Mao spice blend is not itemised; Chinese spice mixes sometimes carry wheat. Ask.

items.ja: ロングポテトフライ［スパイシー／海苔塩／ハーブソルト］
items.romaji: long potato fry — spicy / nori-shio / herb salt
items.en: Long chips with your choice of spicy, nori-salt or herb-salt seasoning
items.note: 共用フライヤーで小麦の衣物（フリット・唐揚げ）と同じ油。The fryer also handles wheat-battered fritto and karaage, so cross-contact is likely even if the chips and salt are clean.

items.ja: タンドリーチキン唐揚げ トマトヨーグルトとソルティヨーグルト
items.romaji: tandoori chicken karaage, tomato yoghurt to salty yoghurt
items.en: Tandoori-marinated chicken karaage with two yoghurt dips, tomato and salted
items.note: 唐揚げの衣は小麦粉・片栗粉、ヨーグルトは乳。Karaage coating is wheat-and-starch and the dips are dairy.

items.ja: 牛ほほ肉とローズマリーの赤ワイン煮込み
items.romaji: gyu-hoho-niku to rosemary no akawain nikomi
items.en: Beef cheek slow-braised in red wine with rosemary — the biggest plate on the food card
items.note: 赤ワイン煮込みのソースは小麦粉でとろみをつける場合がある。French-style braises are commonly thickened with flour — ask.

items.ja: 鶏むね肉のバターソテー ベルガモットとカルダモンのクリームソース

tokyo_spice_curry_hachiwan_jim.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Taken from the shop's own 神保町店 page and the chain menu block on hachiwan-curry.com, read 2026-08-20. Address on the branch page is 〒101-0065 東京都千代田区西神田2-5-2 Tasビル1F, 11:00–20:30 — matching the Jimbocho record. The two named curries are the branch's current line-up and rotate; the 店主の気まぐれカリー is a chef's-whim slot that changes. HOW IT WORKS: you order and pay at the till (curry + rice choice, plus any hot snack or drink), then take your plate to the achar buffet and help yourself to as many of the fermented vegetable side dishes as you like — the buffet is included, not extra. A student discount is offered and takeaway is available. NOTE the 豊洲千客万来 branch has no buffet, and as of 2026-08-18 it has been relaunched as a スパイスカツカリー (breaded-cutlet) shop — that is a different branch and its cutlets would not be gluten-free.

Ask for this one specifically.

tokyo_asakusa_monja_okonomiyak.price_note: Prices approximate — may change, and these are TAX-EXCLUSIVE: the list carries 「※表示価格は税抜きです」, so add 10% at the till. items.ja: 梅ジソ ササミもんじゃ

items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage with plum paste

items.en: A whole pickled cucumber on a stick

items.en: Raw green peppers with meat miso

items.en: Cabbage tossed with salted kombu

items.en: 'Jou' nigiri set — 7 pieces plus a roll
items.note: Edomae nigiri. Sushi rice is seasoned with vinegar (fine) but the shari and the neta are eaten with 醤油 — Japanese soy sauce is brewed with wheat by default — and the shop's own photo of the set shows 玉子 (egg, usually contains mirin/soy) and 穴子 glazed with ツメ, a soy-and-mirin reduction. Fish and rice, so not vegan.

items.ja: おまかせにぎり 12貫 巻物 (お椀付)

items.note: The shop's photo of this set shows tuna, kohada, uni, ikura, sweet shrimp, tamagoyaki, prawn, anago and a shiso roll. 穴子 carries ツメ (soy/mirin glaze) and 玉子焼き normally contains soy; assume wheat.

items.en: 'Jou' chirashi — assorted sashimi over sushi rice
items.note: Eaten with soy sauce, and the shop's chirashi photo includes tamagoyaki and glazed anago. Wheat via soy unless a gluten-free tamari is supplied.

items.en: Premium chirashi with a soup bowl
items.note: Same as 上ちらし plus the clam miso soup.

items.en: Tekka-don — tuna sashimi over sushi rice
items.note: Raw tuna and rice only, so the bowl itself may be wheat-free — but it is served to be eaten with soy sauce and usually arrives with wasabi and a soy dressing. Ask for the fish plain and bring your own tamari.

items.en: Battera — Osaka-style pressed mackerel sushi, the shop's signature
items.note: The shop calls this its 名物. Battera is pressed cured mackerel over vinegared rice under a sheet of 白板昆布. The cure is salt + vinegar, so it can be wheat-free — but many shops add a little soy or mirin to the marinade and to the kombu sheet. Ask before eating; the shop publishes no allergen list.

items.en: Tekkamaki — tuna rolls
items.note: Tuna, rice and nori are wheat-free in themselves, but the roll is served for dipping in wheat-brewed soy sauce.

items.ja: のり巻き(かんぴょう、梅じそ、かっぱ、たくわん、各種3本)
items.en: Nori rolls — kanpyo (gourd), ume-shiso, cucumber or takuwan pickle; 3 rolls of one kind
items.note: かっぱ (cucumber) and 梅じそ are plant-only fillings, but かんぴょう is simmered in soy sauce and sugar — wheat, and usually a bonito dashi. Takuwan is normally vegan but is often coloured/seasoned. Nothing here is safe for gluten; a cucumber roll eaten without soy sauce is the closest to vegan, so ask.

items.en: Assorted sashimi platter
items.note: Raw fish with wasabi is naturally gluten-free; the risk is entirely the dipping soy sauce (wheat) and any shared board. Bring tamari and ask the counter to plate it without sauce.

items.en: Conger eel grilled plain ('white-grilled'), no glaze
items.note: 白焼き means grilled WITHOUT the soy-and-mirin ツメ glaze — the shop's own menu page contrasts it with 穴子のツメ. Salt-grilled eel can be wheat-free, but shirayaki is conventionally served with salt or wasabi-soy, and the same grill handles the glazed version. Confirm no tare touched it.

items.en: Octopus sashimi
items.note: Boiled octopus, plain. Wheat risk is the soy dip only.

items.en: Kazunoko — salted herring roe
items.note: Kazunoko is desalted then steeped in a dashi-and-soy marinade (味付け数の子) in almost every sushi shop — soy is wheat and the dashi is bonito. Fish roe, so not vegan.

items.en: Squid tentacles, a small drinking snack
items.note: The menu does not say whether it is boiled, grilled or fried; げそ is commonly served 唐揚げ (wheat-dusted, shared fryer) or with a soy dressing. Ask how it is cooked.

items.en: Soup bowl — freshwater clam miso soup
items.note: Miso is a fermented soy paste that may be barley-based (麦味噌) and the broth is built on clams and usually bonito dashi. Shellfish stock means not vegan; unspecified miso means not gluten-free.

items.en: Seasoned bamboo shoots
items.note: Menma is simmered in a soy-based seasoning as a rule; the shop publishes no per-topping allergen line, so treat as soy/wheat unless the counter says otherwise.

items.en: Seasoned soft-boiled egg

items.en: Pulled special char siu pork

items.en: Tsukemen, large noodle portion (surcharge)

items.en: Tsukemen, extra-large noodle portion (surcharge)

items.en: Canned beer

items.en: Black oolong tea (bottled)

tokyo_nikumaru_sakaba_suidobas.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. The shop publishes no allergen chart, so every gluten call below is read off the dish name and Japanese izakaya practice, not off a shop statement.

items.en: 'Cheese-toro' — melted cheese over minced fatty tuna or beef, the house speed-snack

items.en: Fried chicken karaage

items.en: Fried chicken cartilage

items.note: Same soy marinade, same flour dusting, same shared fryer.

items.en: Fried chicken wings

items.en: Salted green soybeans in the pod

items.ja: やみつきガーリックシュリンプ

items.note: Egg — not vegan. The dashi in a commercial dashimaki is almost always 白だし or めんつゆ, which are soy-sauce based and therefore wheat, and bonito besides. A classic dish that looks safe and is not.

items.en: Fried octopus
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes

items.en: Stir-fried cabbage

items.en: Breaded fried salmon

items.note: フライ means panko breadcrumbs — wheat — and it comes with tartare or a wheat-containing sauce.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (quick-menu portion)
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish. Carpaccio dressing here is undocumented; Japanese versions often use a soy-and-olive-oil dressing, so ask.

items.en: Tuna carpaccio
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Raw fish; dressing undocumented, likely soy-based.

items.en: Fried mehikari (greeneye) — small whole deep-water fish
items.section: スピードメニュー Quick dishes
items.note: Flour-dusted, shared fryer.

items.ja: 旨辛ささみスティック
items.en: Spicy chicken-tender sticks

items.en: Fried cheese wontons

items.en: Salted cucumber sticks

items.ja: レバーパテとバケット

items.ja: 生ハムとトマトのブルスケッタ

items.en: Cabbage with anchovy

items.ja: 海老とトマトのアヒージョ
items.en: Prawn and tomato in garlic oil
items.note: Prawns; served with bread as standard.

items.en: Garlic toast
items.note: Bread — wheat. Usually buttered, so dairy too.

items.en: Assorted prosciutto and cured hams
items.note: Cured pork. Dry-cured ham is normally just pork and salt, but the plate arrives with bread or grissini as standard — ask for it plain.

items.ja: サーモンカルパッチョ
items.en: Salmon carpaccio (à la carte portion)
items.note: Larger version of the quick-menu dish. Raw fish; dressing undocumented.

items.en: Cheese board
items.note: Dairy. Cheese boards are served with crackers or bread — ask for it without.

items.en: Fresh (unfried) Vietnamese-style spring rolls
items.note: The wrapper for 生春巻き is rice paper, not wheat — genuinely different from a fried 春巻き. But the filling normally contains prawn and the dipping sauce is either hoisin (wheat) or nuoc cham (fish sauce), so this is 'ask', not 'gf', and not vegan as served.

items.ja: ムール貝の白ワイン蒸し
items.en: Mussels steamed in white wine
items.note: Shellfish. Steamed in wine, garlic and butter — no wheat in the classic recipe, but the bread comes with it and no ingredient list is published.

items.ja: フィッシュアンドチップス
items.en: Fish and chips
items.note: Beer batter — wheat twice over (flour and malt) — and the chips share that fryer.

items.ja: ナチョス〜贅沢トッピング〜
items.en: Nachos loaded with avocado, chilli beans, sour cream and jalapeño
items.note: Sour cream and usually melted cheese — not vegan. Corn tortilla chips carry no wheat as a rule, but Japanese-market brands often blend in wheat flour and the fryer is shared; ask.

items.en: Chips / french fries
items.note: Potato itself is wheat-free, but this kitchen fries panko-breaded salmon, karaage and beer-battered fish — a shared fryer means shared gluten.

items.en: Caprese — tomato and mozzarella
items.note: Fresh cheese. Tomato, cheese, oil and basil carry no wheat, but no allergen line is published.

items.ja: ファーマーズバーニャカウダ
items.en: Farmer's bagna cauda — raw vegetables with warm anchovy-garlic dip
items.note: Anchovy and dairy in the dip — not vegan. Bagna cauda normally has no wheat; unverified here.

items.ja: 炙りマグロのニース風サラダ
items.en: Seared tuna niçoise salad
items.note: Tuna and egg. Dressing undocumented; a 'seared' Japanese preparation often means a soy marinade.

items.en: House special salad
items.note: Contents not published. Ask what is in it and what the dressing is — that is where the wheat and the animal products live in a Japanese salad.

items.en: Italian salad
items.note: Contents not published; likely cheese and croutons, both of which would change the answer.

items.en: Four-cheese pizza
items.note: Wheat dough and dairy.

items.ja: ベーコンとほうれん草のピザ
items.en: Bacon and spinach pizza

items.ja: マルゲリータ ピザ

items.en: Seafood pizza

items.ja: ベーコンとナスのトマトソース

items.ja: タリアテッレうにクリームソース

items.ja: 渡り蟹のトマトクリームソースリングイネ

items.en: Lasagne

items.ja: ベトナム風レモングラス チキングリル
items.en: Vietnamese-style grilled lemongrass chicken
items.note: Chicken. Vietnamese lemongrass marinades use fish sauce and often soy or oyster sauce — ask, and note fish sauce also rules out vegan.

items.ja: スペシャル肉と野菜のコンボ

items.en: Special meat-and-vegetable combination plate

items.en: Beef tongue with scallion and salt
items.note: Beef. A 塩 (salt) preparation is the better bet in a soy-heavy kitchen — negishio sauce is scallion, sesame oil, salt and lemon — but many versions add a splash of soy, and no ingredient line is published.

items.en: Beef steak
items.note: Beef. In a Japanese izakaya the steak sauce is normally soy-based; ask for it plain with salt.

items.ja: ハワイスタイルプープスペアリブ

items.ja: 豚肉のタンドール焼き

items.ja: ローズマリーローストチキン
items.en: Rosemary roast chicken
items.note: Chicken. Herb-roasted meat is often free of wheat, but the pan jus is unstated.

items.ja: アスパラチキンチーズ
items.en: Chicken with asparagus and cheese
items.note: Chicken and dairy; preparation unstated — if it is rolled and breaded it is wheat, so ask.

items.ja: 自家製 柔らか本格ローストビーフ
items.en: House-made tender roast beef
items.note: The beef itself is just beef, but Japanese roast-beef sauce is a soy-and-onion gravy as standard — wheat. Ask whether it can be served with only salt and horseradish.

items.ja: ソーセージ盛り合わせ
items.en: Assorted sausages
items.note: Pork. Sausage binders often include wheat rusk or starch, and mustard aside the accompaniments are unstated.

items.note: Beef. Brazilian churrasco is traditionally seasoned with nothing but coarse salt, which would make it one of the safest things on this menu — but this kitchen publishes no seasoning statement and Japanese churrasco houses commonly brush a garlic-soy marinade on. Ask specifically whether the rub is salt only.

items.ja: レモンチェッロのティラミス

items.ja: フォンダンショコラ バニラアイスクリーム添え

items.ja: チューハイ（ウーロンハイ／緑茶ハイ）

items.en: Cocktails — cassis, peach, lychee, gin and vodka bases with a long list of mixers

READ THIS FIRST: the site's own footer states 「※実店舗はございません。通販をご利用ください。」 — there is NO walk-in shop at the Matsugaya address; it is a workshop and mail-order only, with phone ordering 10:00–18:00, closed Wed and Sun. Items marked 【冷凍】 ship frozen. The shop's materials page states: 「小麦・乳製品・卵を使用せず、代わりに米粉などのグルテンを含まない粉類や、植物性の素材だけを使っています。また、植物性・グルテンフリー専門の工房ですので、これらの原料の工房への持ち込みもなく、コンタミネーションの心配はございません。」 — a dedicated plant-based and gluten-free workshop with no wheat, dairy or egg brought onto the premises. That is a FACILITY-level claim, not just a product one, and every product page carries its own 特定原材料（28品目中） line — none of the ones checked names 小麦. Sweeteners are てんさい糖 / メープルシロップ / 米飴, i.e. no honey. Product names have had a trailing SKU artefact ("_n", "_") trimmed; 「紙袋付き / 紙袋なし」 marks the with- or without-gift-bag variant of the same tin.

items.note: もんじゃ焼き＝小麦粉と出汁を溶いた生地. Monja batter is wheat flour slaked with dashi, cooked on a griddle shared with okonomiyaki and yakisoba — wheat by definition and by contact. Fish sausage and chikuwa are surimi; the dashi is bonito.

items.en: Gomoku yakisoba — pork and seafood, a big plate
items.section: 焼きそば・焼きうどん Yakisoba & yaki-udon

items.en: Yaki-udon, finished with the house sauce
items.section: 焼きそば・焼きうどん Yakisoba & yaki-udon
items.note: うどん＝小麦. Udon is wheat, and the finish is sauce.

items.en: Griddled pork offal — the shop's self-declared number-one snack
items.note: Horumon tare is soy-sauce and miso based, i.e. wheat, and it is cooked on the same griddle as the wheat-batter dishes.

items.en: Simmered beef tendon — the shop calls it the thing to order first on Hoppy Street
items.note: Beef tendon simmered in soy sauce and mirin — wheat by default in Japan unless a gluten-free tamari is named, and it is not.

items.en: Griddled onion in butter with the owner's own tare
items.note: Dairy butter, so not vegan. The 'ママが作った絶品のタレ' is unspecified — a house tare in an izakaya is soy-sauce based unless told otherwise, and the griddle is shared with wheat batter, so ask before assuming.

items.en: Squid tentacles stir-fried with kimchi in the house tare
items.note: House tare (soy-based) plus kimchi, which normally carries fish sauce or salted shrimp; squid.

items.en: Blanched cabbage with the owner's own blended miso
items.note: Just cabbage and miso, so the closest thing to a plant dish here — but a blended Japanese miso may be 麦味噌 (barley miso, a gluten grain that is NOT on Japan's statutory allergen list), and household miso dips routinely carry dashi or mirin. Ask what is in the blend.

items.en: Draught beer, medium or small glass. A 一口生 taster size is also poured
items.note: Beer is brewed from barley malt — never gluten-free. Fining agents mean vegan status varies by brand.

items.en: Bottled beer, medium bottle — Kirin Lager or Asahi Super Dry
items.note: Barley malt — not gluten-free. Both Kirin Lager and Asahi Super Dry are malt-and-rice lagers with no animal ingredient.

items.ja: 各種 サワー（酎ハイ）

items.en: Fresh grape sour

items.en: Shochu highball with a pickled plum

items.en: Hoppy, white or black — the low-alcohol malt mixer Asakusa's Hoppy Street is named for, served with shochu

items.ja: ハイボール サントリー角

items.note: Blended Japanese whisky is distilled from malted barley. Distillation removes most gluten protein but this app does not flag malt drinks gluten-free.

items.en: House-made plum wine, on the rocks or with soda — the owner's recommendation
items.note: Umeshu is plums and rock sugar steeped in a spirit — commonly white liquor, but sometimes 麦焼酎 (barley). Home-made versions occasionally use honey. Ask.

items.en: Denki Bran — the 1880s Asakusa brandy-based liqueur, drunk here as the local ritual
items.note: A blend of brandy, gin, wine, curaçao and herbs whose full composition the maker does not publish; grain spirit cannot be ruled out. Ask, or skip if strict.

items.ja: フレッシュジュース（グレープフルーツ生搾り）
items.en: Fresh-squeezed grapefruit juice
items.note: Squeezed fruit and nothing else — no wheat, no barley, no animal ingredient.

items.ja: 各種 ジュース類（全11種類）
items.en: Soft drinks, eleven kinds
items.note: The eleven are not itemised on either of the shop's pages, so the individual drinks are not assessed here.

items.ja: ウーロン茶・冷やし緑茶
items.en: Oolong tea or chilled green tea
items.note: Oolong and green tea are tea leaf and water — no grain. Note this is NOT 麦茶, which is barley and would not be gluten-free.

tokyo_80_yen_yakitori_nobunaga.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Tax-included, from the shop-managed (公式) Tabelog menu, 更新日 2026/08/14 — eleven days old at the time of checking, so these are current. Address on the same page is 千代田区神田三崎町3-3-18 AB.River水道橋 1F, which is the Suidobashi branch this record means. The shop's `website` field points at gd6p907.gorp.jp, which now serves a Gnavi CAPTCHA; r.gnavi.co.jp/gd6p907/ redirects to the same shop and answers. The '80-yen yakitori' of the name is the pre-tax price: skewers ring up at ¥88 and ¥97 tax-included. The whole card runs to 70 food items, 64 drinks, 11 lunch items and 8 courses; this is the food card. Kara-age is ordered off a separate 早見表 card above the counter, not from this list.

items.ja: やきとり盛合せ 10本盛合せ
items.en: Yakitori assortment, ten skewers
items.note: An assortment arrives tare-glazed unless you ask for 塩. 焼き鳥のタレ＝醤油・みりんベース, and Japanese soy sauce is brewed with wheat by default. Even ordered 塩, the skewers are grilled over the same fire and brushed area as tare skewers.

items.ja: やきとり盛合せ 5本盛合せ
items.en: Yakitori assortment, five skewers
items.note: Same tare question as the ten-skewer set — soy-sauce glaze, wheat by default.

items.en: Three skewers buried under a heap of spring onion
items.note: Chicken skewers with a soy-based tare or a negi dressing; wheat by default.

items.en: Three skewers with spring onion and natto
items.note: Chicken, plus natto — whose sachet tare is soy-sauce based (wheat) and often contains bonito extract.

items.en: Chicken thigh skewer. Choose salt or tare, and choose how many
items.note: The cheapest skewer on the board — this is the '80 yen' of the shop's name, ¥88 with tax. たれ is soy-sauce based, so wheat; 塩 is the safer order but the same grill carries tare skewers.

items.en: Chicken and spring onion skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; the tare is wheat soy sauce and drips onto the shared grill.

items.en: Chicken neck skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Chicken skin skewer
items.note: Usually served tare-glazed; soy sauce is wheat.

items.en: Chicken tenderloin skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce. Sasami is often finished with wasabi or plum paste, which carry their own seasonings.

items.en: Chicken tail (parson's nose) skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Chicken breast-bone cartilage skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Chicken heart skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Chicken aorta skewer — limited number each night
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Ultra-fresh pale chicken liver skewer
items.note: Liver skewers are almost always tare-glazed — wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Chicken gizzard skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Minced chicken meatball skewer
items.note: Tsukune is bound with egg and, very commonly, panko or flour, then glazed with soy tare — the worst of the skewers for a coeliac.

items.en: Chicken wing
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Pork belly skewer
items.note: Salt or tare; tare is wheat soy sauce.

items.en: Beef short-rib skewer
items.note: Karubi is normally marinated in a soy-sauce, mirin and sesame tare — wheat.

items.en: Grilled onion skewer
items.note: Onion alone is a plant food, but on a yakitori grill it is brushed with the same tare as the chicken (wheat soy sauce) unless you order 塩, and it cooks over dripping chicken fat. Ask for 塩 and ask about the grill.

items.en: Grilled leek skewer
items.note: Same as the onion: plant food, but tare and shared grill unless you specify 塩.

items.en: Grilled mountain yam skewer
items.note: Yam is plant food; the tare and the shared grill are the questions. やまいも is itself a listed allergen in Japan.

items.en: Grilled king oyster mushroom skewer
items.note: Mushroom is plant food; ask for 塩 and ask whether it shares the tare brush and grill with chicken.

items.en: Grilled shiitake skewer
items.note: Same as the eringi — the mushroom is fine, the tare and the grill are not established.

items.en: Grilled quail-egg skewer
items.note: Egg, so not vegan despite sitting under the vegetable heading. Usually tare-glazed.

items.en: Grilled ginkgo nut skewer
items.note: Ginkgo nuts are usually just salted, which would make this the plainest thing on the skewer list — but confirm the salt-only preparation and the shared grill.

items.ja: 三代目 もつ煮込み
items.en: 'Third-generation' simmered pork offal — the house dish since the shop opened, reworked
items.section: 三代目 信長の煮込み Simmered offal
items.note: Motsu-nikomi is simmered in miso and/or soy sauce. Both are wheat questions: soy sauce is wheat-brewed by default and the miso may be 麦味噌 (barley).

items.en: Garlic chives scrambled with egg on the hotplate
items.note: Egg. The seasoning is not stated; a griddle dish in an izakaya is normally finished with soy sauce or an oyster/soy sauce, so ask.

items.en: Spring onion, egg and natto on the hotplate
items.note: Egg plus natto — the natto tare is soy-sauce based (wheat) and generally carries bonito extract.

items.en: Nobunaga's tonpeiyaki — pork and egg on the hotplate
items.note: Tonpeiyaki is wrapped in a thin wheat-batter crêpe or egg sheet and finished with okonomi sauce and mayonnaise — wheat and egg.

items.en: Tomato baked with cheese on the hotplate
items.note: Dairy cheese. Wheat status depends on the seasoning and whether the same hotplate cooks the tonpeiyaki batter — ask.

items.en: Mountain yam baked with cheese on the hotplate
items.note: Dairy cheese; grated yam dishes are usually loosened with dashi or mentsuyu, which is soy sauce, i.e. wheat. Ask.

items.en: Fried chicken finished nanban-style on the hotplate — sweet-vinegar sauce and tartare
items.note: 唐揚げ＝小麦粉／片栗粉の衣 plus a nanban sauce built on soy sauce and vinegar, plus egg mayonnaise. Wheat, egg, and a shared fryer.

items.en: House potato salad (add a soft-boiled egg for ¥100)
items.note: Japanese potato salad is bound with egg mayonnaise, and often carries ham. Kewpie-style mayonnaise uses rice/apple vinegar rather than malt, but the ham and any seasoning are unverified — ask.

items.en: Tofu salad with sesame dressing
items.note: Commercial 胡麻ドレッシング is built on soy sauce (wheat) and normally contains egg yolk; Japanese tofu salads are also usually topped with bonito flakes.

items.en: Caesar salad with a soft-poached egg
items.note: Caesar dressing is egg, parmesan and anchovy, and the salad is normally scattered with wheat croutons.

items.ja: 信長特製 キャベツ盛り
items.en: Nobunaga's cabbage plate — with salted kombu and the house chilli miso (heat ★★)
items.note: Raw cabbage with 塩昆布 and a 自家製辛味噌. The kombu seasoning is normally soy-based, and the chilli miso may be 麦味噌 (barley) — both gluten questions, and a chilli miso often carries dashi. Ask for the cabbage plain if you want the safest version.

items.en: Thick-cut crumbed ham cutlet, one slice
items.note: カツ＝パン粉衣. Panko crumb is wheat bread, plus flour and egg in the coating, in a shared fryer.

items.en: Cheese-filled spring rolls
items.note: 春巻きの皮＝小麦. Spring-roll wrappers are wheat, plus dairy cheese.

items.en: Deep-fried chicken cartilage
items.note: Dusted and fried; even a potato-starch dusting goes into the same oil as the panko cutlets and spring rolls.

items.en: Deep-fried takoyaki
items.note: たこ焼き＝小麦粉生地. Wheat batter, wheat-thickened sauce, egg mayonnaise, bonito flakes, shared fryer.

items.ja: 新潟名物 栃尾揚げ
items.en: Tochio abura-age — Niigata's giant deep-fried tofu slab, re-grilled
items.note: The tofu slab itself is soy and oil, but it is served with a soy-sauce and spring-onion or miso topping, sometimes with bonito flakes, and it goes through the shared fryer. Ask about both the topping and the oil.

items.ja: 昔懐かし赤ウィンナー
items.en: Nostalgic red mini sausages
items.note: Pork sausage. Japanese sausage fillers often include wheat protein, and this is cooked in the shared fryer.

items.en: Fried potato-and-cheese mochi
items.note: Dairy cheese; the shared fryer carries panko and spring-roll wrapper.

items.ja: カニクリームコロッケ
items.en: Crab cream croquettes
items.note: A cream croquette is a wheat-flour béchamel in a panko crumb — wheat twice over, plus dairy and crab.

items.en: Deep-fried octopus
items.note: 唐揚げ is dusted in flour or potato starch after a soy-sauce marinade, and fried in the shared oil.

items.ja: 鶏白レバーの低温調理刺し
items.romaji: tori shiro liver teion chori sashi
items.en: Low-temperature-cooked pale chicken liver, served as sashimi — the shop's signature
items.note: Liver sashimi is eaten with soy sauce, sesame oil and salt — the soy sauce is wheat.

items.en: Cold tofu
items.note: Chilled tofu comes with soy sauce (wheat) and is nearly always topped with bonito flakes. Ask for it with nothing on it and no soy and you are down to plain tofu and ginger.

items.en: Seared edamame
items.note: Edamame and salt would be plant food and grain-free, but 炙り means these go over the yakitori grill where tare drips, and a seared version is often brushed with something. Ask.

items.en: Mountain yam cut into batons
items.note: Served with soy sauce and nori, and usually a bonito garnish — wheat and fish.

items.en: Chilled tomato
items.note: Plain chilled tomato is the most likely thing on this card to be both plant-based and grain-free — but izakaya versions arrive with an onion dressing or mayonnaise. Ask for it undressed.

items.ja: たたききゅうり(梅しそ和え)
items.en: Smashed cucumber dressed with pickled plum and shiso
items.note: Cucumber, umeboshi and shiso are plant foods, but the dressing usually includes soy sauce, mentsuyu or sesame oil with dashi. Ask what the 和え is made with.

items.en: Lightly pickled Chinese cabbage
items.note: Asazuke is cabbage, salt and kombu in the simplest form, but commercial pickling liquors routinely include soy sauce, amino-acid seasoning or bonito. Ask.

items.en: Nozawana greens pickled with wasabi
items.note: わさび漬け is traditionally made with 酒粕 (sake lees) and is commercially seasoned with soy sauce; the greens are also usually soy-marinated. Treat as wheat.

items.en: Raw octopus in wasabi
items.note: Octopus, and the wasabi paste is built on sake lees and soy seasoning.

items.en: Chanja — Korean-style spiced salted cod tripe
items.note: Fermented fish offal seasoned with gochujang, which is normally made with wheat flour as well as chilli, plus fish sauce.

items.en: Ume-suisho — shark cartilage with pickled plum
items.note: Shark cartilage; the standard seasoning is soy sauce and mirin, i.e. wheat.

items.en: Grilled dried skate fin
items.note: Dried fish, grilled over the yakitori fire and served with mayonnaise and shichimi — fish, egg, and a tare-splashed grill.

items.en: Seared vinegar-cured mackerel
items.note: Mackerel, and it is eaten with soy sauce; the cure itself often uses a kombu-and-vinegar base with mirin.

items.en: Plain white rice
items.note: Plain steamed Japanese rice is naturally grain-safe and plant-based — order it unseasoned, do not let anyone pour tare on it, and watch that the scoop has not been in something else. That is the survival option on this whole menu.

items.en: The closing bowl of ramen
items.note: ラーメンの麺＝小麦, and the soup is a soy or chicken tare. Wheat twice over.

items.ja: お茶漬け（梅・明太子・ねぎ納豆・野沢菜わさび）
items.en: Ochazuke — rice in tea/broth, choice of plum, mentaiko, spring-onion natto or wasabi nozawana
items.note: Ochazuke broth is made from a dashi packet or 白だし, which is soy sauce and therefore wheat as well as bonito. Every one of the four toppings is separately soy-seasoned.

items.ja: 信長謹製つくね月見丼
items.en: Tsukune rice bowl with a raw egg yolk
items.note: Tsukune is normally bound with panko or flour and glazed with soy tare; the yolk is raw egg.

items.en: 'Stupid-size' prawn crackers, party portion for 4–5 (mini portion for 2–3 at ¥418)
items.section: 信長名物 バカ盛り Party-size platters
items.note: Prawn crackers, i.e. shellfish; Japanese ebisen dough normally includes wheat flour alongside the starch, and they are fried in the shared oil.

items.ja: バカ盛りポテトフライ
items.en: 'Stupid-size' chips for 4–5 (mini for 2–3 at ¥528; three seasoning powders +¥100)
items.section: 信長名物 バカ盛り Party-size platters
items.note: Potato and oil are plant food, but they share a fryer with panko cutlets, spring rolls and takoyaki — a coeliac cannot eat from that oil. The flavour powders are also unspecified.

items.en: 'Stupid-size' green salad for 4–5 (mini for 2–3 at ¥638)
items.section: 信長名物 バカ盛り Party-size platters
items.note: The leaves are plant food; the dressing is not named. Japanese house dressings are usually soy or sesame based (wheat) and often contain egg. Ask for oil and salt.

items.en: 'Stupid-size' stir-fried bean sprouts for 4–5 (mini for 2–3 at ¥638)
items.section: 信長名物 バカ盛り Party-size platters
items.note: Bean sprouts are plant food, but a Japanese moyashi-itame is seasoned with soy sauce and/or an oyster or chicken-stock powder — wheat by default, and often not vegetarian either.

items.ja: 黒蜜ときな粉のバニラアイス
items.romaji: kuromitsu to kinako no vanilla ice
items.en: Vanilla ice cream with black sugar syrup and roasted soy flour
items.note: Dairy ice cream, so not vegan. Kuromitsu is cane sugar and kinako is roasted soybean — neither is a gluten grain, but commercial ice cream can carry a wheat-derived stabiliser. Ask.

tokyo_sharin_shinjuku_center_b.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Tax-included, from the shop-managed (公式) Tabelog menu, 更新日 2026/04/08. 舎鈴 is the everyday-price arm of 松富士食品 (the 六厘舎 group); the branch page is shop.mtfj.co.jp/stores/55, 新宿センタービル B1F. The chain publishes prices only on the branch/Tabelog listing, not on tsukemen-sharin.com, so bowl prices are chain-standard rather than branch-verified — but the branch page carries no price variation notice. The allergen data below is far better sourced than the prices: the chain's own PDF アレルゲン情報 chart, dated 2026年8月21日, gives a 28-allergen row for every single bowl, topping and side. USE THE 関東エリア PAGE (page 1) — page 2 is 関西エリア and the rows differ. The chart's own footnote is the important part for a coeliac: 「当店で使用している調理器具・食器は商品ごとに使い分けをしておりません」— utensils and bowls are NOT separated by product, and the chain says secondary contamination cannot be prevented.

items.en: Tsukemen — the house bowl. Custom medium-thick chewy noodles served cold beside a hot pork-and-chicken dipping broth, rich but with a clean finish. Small ¥790 / regular ¥890 / large ¥990 / extra-large ¥1,090, all the same price for more noodles
items.note: The chain's own 2026-08-21 allergen chart marks つけめん for えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus 牛肉・ごま・さけ・さば・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・りんご・ゼラチン. 小麦 is the noodle (the shop's own copy boasts 小麦の風味を生かした特注中太麺) and the soy-sauce tare. Gelatin and four kinds of meat and fish rule out vegan. Sharin's chart also warns the soup ingredients are landed by a fishery where shrimp and crab mix.

items.en: Tsukemen with a seasoned soft-boiled egg — served whole and uncut so the yolk stays in. Small ¥940 / regular ¥1,040 / large ¥1,140 / extra-large ¥1,240
items.note: Chart row: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus the same meats. The 味玉 has its own row and is itself marked 小麦 — the egg is marinated in soy sauce.

items.en: Dandan tsukemen — a sesame-and-chilli dipping broth done as tsukemen rather than as noodle soup. Small ¥940 / regular ¥1,040 / large ¥1,140 / extra-large ¥1,240
items.note: The only bowl on the chart that also carries 落花生 (peanut) alongside えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳. Wheat noodle and wheat tare.

items.en: Deluxe tsukemen — extra chashu, extra seasoned egg, extra nori. Small ¥1,090 / regular ¥1,190 / large ¥1,290 / extra-large ¥1,390
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳. The 特製盛り topping row is separately marked 小麦・卵 — chashu, seasoned egg and nori are all soy-marinated, so the deluxe adds wheat rather than avoiding it.

items.en: 'Founding' tsukemen — the original recipe. The chain's own menu page notes 一部店舗は未販売, so it may not be sold at this branch
items.note: On the allergen chart (with 創業味玉つけめん and 創業チャーシューつけめん) as えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳. Not on the Tabelog price list for this branch and no price is published anywhere, so no price is recorded here rather than a guessed one.

items.en: Ramen — a faintly aromatic niboshi (dried-sardine) broth with the depth of dark soy, and firm hand-rubbed wrinkled noodles. Regular ¥790 / large ¥890
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus さけ・さば・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉. 濃口醤油 is the stated seasoning — wheat soy sauce — on top of the wheat noodle. The chart adds that the chain's noodles contain NO egg except the miso-ramen noodle, so the 卵 mark here is the topping, not the strand.

items.en: Ramen with a seasoned soft-boiled egg, served uncut. Regular ¥940 / large ¥1,040
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳. Both the noodle and the egg's marinade are wheat.

items.en: Deluxe ramen — extra chashu, seasoned egg and nori. Regular ¥1,090 / large ¥1,190
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus the meats. Every element of the 特製 topping set is separately marked 小麦.

items.en: Plain ramen — noodles and broth with nothing on top. The chart's leanest bowl
items.note: The chart marks 素らーめん for only えび・かに・小麦 plus 大豆・鶏肉 — no egg, no dairy. Still wheat: the noodle and the tare. Included because it is on the chain's own allergen chart; no price is published for it, so none is recorded.

items.en: Morning ramen, served at branches that open early
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦 plus 大豆・鶏肉・豚肉 — no egg or dairy unless you add 味玉. Wheat noodle. No published price.

items.en: Chilled kake ramen — cold broth over cold noodles, a summer bowl. Also sold with myoga, oni-oroshi daikon, shirasu-oroshi or coriander
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 for all five 冷やかけ variants. Cold does not make it wheat-free — same noodle, same soy tare. No published price.

items.en: Miso ramen (with 味玉 and 特製 versions)
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus 牛肉・ごま. The chain's footnote singles this one out — 「味噌ラーメン」の麺には「卵」が含まれております。その他の麺には「卵」を使用しておりません — so the miso bowl is the only one with an egg noodle. No published price.

items.en: Soup-wari — the thin broth poured into your leftover dipping tare at the end to drink it
items.note: Interesting and genuinely useful: the chart marks the スープ割 broth for only えび・かに・大豆 — NO 小麦 of its own. But it goes into a bowl of wheat-bearing dipping tare, so it does not make anything gluten-free; it just tells you the wheat lives in the tare and the noodle, not the stock.

items.en: Braised pork chashu, as a topping
items.note: Own chart row: 小麦 plus オレンジ・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. Braised in a soy-sauce liquor — wheat. No published price.

items.en: Seasoned soft-boiled egg, as a topping
items.note: Own chart row: 小麦・卵 plus さば・大豆. The wheat is the soy-sauce marinade — a plain boiled egg would not be marked. No published price.

items.en: Sheet nori, as a topping
items.note: Own chart row: 小麦・卵. Seaweed itself is neither, so this is a seasoned/glazed nori. The chart also states 海苔は、エビ、カニが混ざる地域で養殖しています — farmed where shrimp and crab mix. No published price.

items.en: Fermented bamboo shoot, as a topping
items.note: Own chart row: 小麦・乳 plus ごま・大豆・鶏肉. Bamboo shoot is a vegetable but this menma is seasoned with soy sauce, dairy and chicken stock. No published price.

items.en: Spinach, as a topping
items.note: The chart row for ほうれん草 is completely blank — none of the 28 allergens, including 小麦. That is the chain's own statement that this topping carries no wheat ingredient. It is still 'ask', not 'gf', because the chart's own footnote says utensils and bowls are not separated by product and secondary contamination cannot be prevented, and it lands in a wheat broth. No published price.

items.en: Extra spring onion
items.note: Blank row on the chain's allergen chart — no wheat ingredient declared. Same shared-utensil caveat as the spinach. No published price.

items.en: The deluxe topping set — extra chashu, seasoned egg and nori in one
items.note: Own chart row: 小麦・卵 plus オレンジ・さけ・さば・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. No published price.

items.en: A bowl of plain rice
items.note: The most useful line on the whole chart for a coeliac in a ramen shop: the ライス row is entirely blank — no 小麦, no anything, and the footnote says 当店のライスは、国産米を使用しております. So the rice itself is plain Japanese rice with nothing added. It stays 'ask' rather than 'gf' only because the chain states in the same document that cooking utensils and tableware are not separated by product, so a shared scoop in a wheat kitchen is a live risk. No published price.

items.en: Fried rice
items.note: Chart: 小麦・卵 plus オレンジ・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. Fried rice is seasoned with soy sauce — wheat — which is exactly why plain ライス is safe and this is not.

items.en: Chashu over rice
items.note: Chart: 小麦 plus オレンジ・さけ・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. The chashu's soy braise is the wheat. Same for ネギチャーシュー丼.

items.en: Seasoned-egg rice bowl
items.note: Chart: 小麦・卵 plus さけ・さば・大豆・豚肉. Soy-marinated egg over rice.

items.en: Dandan rice bowl
items.note: Chart: 小麦 plus さけ・大豆・豚肉.

items.en: Gyoza — the chain's menu page flags them as sold only at certain branches (→販売店舗)
items.note: Chart: 小麦・乳 plus 牛肉・ごま・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. 餃子の皮＝小麦 — the wrapper is wheat, as always. Check whether the Shinjuku Center Building branch sells them at all.

items.en: Myoga ginger bud — topping
items.note: Blank row on the chain's own 2026-08-21 allergen chart — none of the 28 allergens declared, so no wheat ingredient of its own. It still goes into a wheat bowl and the chart's footnote states 「当店で使用している調理器具・食器は商品ごとに使い分けをしておりません」— utensils and crockery are NOT separated by product, so secondary contamination cannot be excluded. No published price.

items.en: Coarsely grated daikon — topping
items.note: Blank row on the chain's own allergen chart — no declared allergen, i.e. plain grated daikon with no soy seasoning. Same shared-utensil caveat as the other blank rows. No published price.

items.en: Grated daikon with whitebait — topping
items.note: Whitebait — fish, so not vegan. The chart row is blank for all 28 allergens (しらす is not itself a listed allergen), so no wheat is declared, but shared utensils apply. No published price.

items.en: Coriander leaf — topping
items.note: Blank row on the chain's own allergen chart — a plain herb, no declared allergen. Shared utensils apply. No published price.

items.en: Lemon — topping
items.note: Blank row on the chain's own allergen chart. Shared utensils apply. No published price.

items.en: Children's ramen — sold as a single bowl or as a set
items.note: Chart: えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 plus オレンジ・さけ・さば・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン; the セット version adds もも・りんご and やまいも. Wheat noodle and wheat tare — a children's portion is not a milder allergen profile. No published price.

items.ja: 茗荷冷やかけ / 鬼おろし冷やかけ / しらすおろし冷やかけ / パクチー冷やかけ
items.en: Chilled 'hiyakake' ramen — myoga, grated daikon, whitebait or coriander versions
items.note: All four variants carry えび・かに・小麦・卵・乳 on the chain's own chart, exactly like the plain 冷やかけ. The blank-row garnish on top does not rescue the bowl underneath. No published prices.

items.en: Frozen raw gyoza, to take home
items.note: Chart: 小麦・乳 plus 牛肉・ごま・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉・ゼラチン. 餃子の皮＝小麦. No published price.

items.en: Loosening broth — added to every delivery/takeout tsukemen
items.note: Chart row: えび・かに plus 大豆 only — NO 小麦 declared, the same as スープ割. Shellfish, so not vegan (and the chart notes 「スープで使用している材料は、エビ、カニが混ざる漁法で捕獲しています」). The chart states this is attached to all delivery tsukemen. Interesting on its own, but it is poured into a wheat bowl.

tokyo_mugi_no_oto.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Tax-included. The shop's own site mugioto.com carries no menu at all, only hours and an Instagram link, so the item list comes from the shop-managed Gurunavi page r.gnavi.co.jp/geum9ft30000 (address on it: 東京都新宿区歌舞伎町1-12-15, matching mugioto.com's 新宿第7ビル B1). Confidence is medium for one reason: the Gurunavi prices and the Tabelog registration (更新日 2025/07/31) DISAGREE on two dishes — the Awaji beef rump is ¥2,800 on Gurunavi and ¥2,600 on Tabelog, the Nagano duck ¥1,800 vs ¥1,700. Gurunavi is taken as the newer figure and the Tabelog one is given in the note. Two dishes on the Tabelog list (the Nagasaki amberjack carpaccio ¥1,800 and the two 自家製 dolci at ¥800/¥900) are absent from Gurunavi and vice versa; both sets are recorded, flagged. Hours 18:00–05:00 Tue–Sun. The kitchen accepts allergy requests — the course pages state 「※アレルギーがございましたら当日スタッフまでお申し付けください」 — but publishes no allergen chart, so every gf/vegan value below is reasoning from the dish name. THE NAME IS A WARNING: 麦ノ音 means 'the sound of BARLEY'; this is a craft-beer bar with six rotating taps, and barley is a gluten grain.

items.ja: 群馬県川場産ブラッタチーズと季節果実のカプレーゼ
items.romaji: Gunma Kawaba-san burrata to kisetsu kajitsu no caprese
items.en: Caprese of Kawaba (Gunma) burrata with the season's fruit — figs from Wakayama at the time the Tabelog card was written
items.note: Burrata is dairy — not vegan. No wheat ingredient is implied by the dish, but the kitchen serves garlic toast and pasta and publishes no allergen information; ask whether anything crisp comes with it.

items.ja: 長崎県産カンパチの炙りカルパッチョ
items.en: Seared carpaccio of Nagasaki amberjack
