items.note: Prawn and fish sauce, so not vegan. Thai noodle soups are usually rice noodles, which would be wheat-free, but this dish does not state its noodle and the tom yum base commonly includes soy-based seasoning. Ask which noodle and whether soy sauce is used.

items.en: Gyoza, five pieces — the shop's own filling. Also tom yum gyoza ¥836 and coriander gyoza ¥836, each five pieces, all served with a special dipping sauce
items.section: NEW！特製タレ付き餃子 Gyoza with house dipping sauce
items.note: A gyoza wrapper is wheat dough — this is unambiguous. The dipping sauce will be soy-based as well. Meat filling.

items.ja: 生春巻（ポーピアソッド）
items.en: Fresh spring rolls — soft rice-paper rolls, not fried
items.note: Fresh spring rolls are wrapped in rice paper rather than wheat, and are not fried, so they avoid two of this kitchen's wheat routes — but the filling normally contains prawn or pork and the dipping sauce is the open question (Thai plum or sweet chilli sauce is usually wheat-free; a hoisin-style peanut sauce is not). Ask about both wrapper and sauce.

items.ja: 春雨サラダ（ヤムウンセン）
items.en: Yam woon sen — spicy glass-noodle salad. Chilli level 2.
items.note: ウンセン glass noodles are mung-bean starch, not wheat. The dressing is fish sauce and lime (not vegan) and the salad normally carries minced pork and prawn. Wheat would only enter via a seasoning sauce — ask.

items.ja: 青パパイヤのサラダ（ソムタムタイ）
items.en: Som tam — green papaya salad pounded with lime, chilli, peanuts and dried shrimp. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Dried shrimp and fish sauce are in the classic recipe, so not vegan. Structurally wheat-free — but som tam is often finished with a splash of seasoning sauce, and no allergen line is published. Ask.

items.ja: 茄子のサラダ（ヤムマクワ）
items.en: Spicy grilled aubergine salad. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Aubergine-based, but Thai yam dressings are fish sauce and lime and this salad usually carries minced pork or dried shrimp. Ask on both counts.

items.ja: 豚肉とハーブのスパイシーサラダ（ムーナムトック）
items.en: Nam tok mu — spicy salad of grilled pork with herbs and toasted rice powder. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Pork. The toasted rice powder is rice; the dressing is fish sauce and lime. Wheat would enter only via seasoning sauce or a soy marinade on the grilled pork — ask.

items.ja: スパイシーな豚挽き肉のレタス（ミアンムータカイ）
items.en: Spicy minced pork wrapped in lettuce leaves. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Pork. Lettuce instead of a wrapper is helpful, but the pork seasoning is undocumented. Ask.

items.ja: 鶏挽肉/豚挽肉のサラダ（ラープガイ）
items.en: Larb — spicy salad of lightly fried minced chicken or pork with toasted rice powder and herbs. Chicken ¥1,199 / pork ¥1,419. Chilli level 2. Marked 定番 (a staple).
items.note: Chicken or pork. Toasted rice powder is rice, dressing is fish sauce and lime — structurally wheat-free, but nothing is published and the mince is 'lightly fried', which raises the shared-fryer question. Ask.

items.ja: シーフードサラダ（ヤムタレー）
items.en: Spicy seafood salad. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Seafood and fish-sauce dressing. Wheat status undocumented — ask about the seasoning sauce.

items.ja: 豚肉のレモンソースかけ（ムーマナーオ）
items.en: Boiled pork in a lemon-garlic-chilli sauce. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Pork; the manao sauce is lime, garlic, chilli and fish sauce. Ask whether seasoning sauce (wheat soy) is added.

items.ja: 鶏肉のグリル（ガイヤーン）
items.en: Gai yang — grilled marinated chicken. Marked 定番 (a staple).
items.note: Chicken. Gai yang's marinade is the problem: it is standardly built on soy sauce and oyster sauce alongside garlic, coriander root and fish sauce. Treat a Thai grill marinade as wheat unless the kitchen tells you otherwise.

items.ja: 豚トロのグリル（コウムゥヤーン）
items.en: Kor mu yang — grilled pork jowl. Marked おすすめ (the shop's recommendation).
items.note: Pork. Same marinade issue as gai yang — soy and oyster sauce are standard, and the accompanying nam jim jaew dipping sauce is fish sauce, chilli and toasted rice.

items.ja: 大海老のグリル（クンパオ）
items.en: Grilled large prawn
items.note: Prawn. A whole grilled prawn is the least-adulterated thing in this section — the risk sits in the seafood dipping sauce, which is normally lime, garlic, chilli and fish sauce and wheat-free, but is not documented. Ask.

items.ja: 豚肉の串焼き 黒こしょう風味（ムゥヤン タイガーデン）
items.en: Black-pepper pork skewers, Thai Garden style — two skewers, in the shop's own sauce
items.note: Pork in a house sauce. A named house sauce on a Thai grill is soy- and oyster-sauce based unless stated otherwise.

items.ja: サテ（鶏肉 or 豚肉）2本
items.en: Satay — two grilled marinated skewers with peanut sauce. Chicken ¥704 / pork ¥814
items.note: Meat, and satay peanut sauce is a curry-paste-and-coconut sauce almost always seasoned with soy sauce; the turmeric marinade normally has soy in it too.

items.ja: 海老の土鍋蒸し（クンオップウンセン）
items.en: Kung ob woon sen — prawns steamed in a clay pot with glass noodles. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: The glass noodles are mung bean, but this dish's whole flavour comes from a soy-sauce, oyster-sauce and Chinese-wine braising liquid poured over the pot. Wheat by construction. Prawn.

items.ja: 蒸し鯛レモンソースかけ（プラーヌンマナーオ）
items.en: Whole steamed sea bream in lemon, garlic and chilli sauce. Chilli level 3.
items.note: Fish. Steamed rather than fried, and the manao sauce is lime, garlic, chilli, coriander and fish sauce — potentially the safest cooked dish on the card for a wheat-avoider. But the stock used to moisten it and any seasoning sauce are undocumented. Ask.

items.ja: 蒸しイカのレモンソースかけ
items.en: Steamed squid in lemon sauce. Chilli level 3.
items.note: Squid; same lime-garlic-chilli sauce as the sea bream, same open question about seasoning sauce.

items.ja: ソフトシェルと卵のカレー炒め（プーニムパッポンカリー）
items.en: Soft-shell crab stir-fried with egg in yellow curry. Chilli level 1. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: The soft-shell crab is dusted in flour and deep-fried before it hits the wok, and phong curry is seasoned with oyster sauce and soy. Egg and crab. Wheat and animal on every axis.

items.ja: 空芯菜炒め（パッパックブンファイデェーン）
items.en: Stir-fried morning glory, flame-tossed. Chilli level 2. Marked 定番.
items.note: A green vegetable, but the classic seasoning for pak bung fai daeng is yellow bean sauce (a fermented soybean paste normally made with wheat flour) plus oyster sauce — that is why gf is no rather than ask. Whether it is vegan depends on the oyster sauce and any fish sauce; ask for it with soybean paste only.

items.ja: バジル炒め（パッガパオ ガイ/ムー/ヌァ）
items.en: Pad kaphrao — minced chicken, pork or beef stir-fried with holy basil and chilli. Chicken ¥1,056 / pork ¥1,166 / beef ¥1,386. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Meat. Kaphrao's sauce is soy sauce, oyster sauce and fish sauce — wheat via both soy and oyster sauce. This is Thailand's most-ordered dish and one of the most reliable gluten traps on any Thai menu.

items.ja: 豆苗炒め（トントウミョウファイデーン）
items.en: Stir-fried pea shoots. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Pea shoots and garlic — nothing animal or wheat is named, which makes this and the bean-sprout-and-tofu stir-fry the two best vegan candidates on the card. The seasoning is undocumented and Thai greens are normally finished with oyster and/or fish sauce. Ask for it with salt and soybean paste only, no oyster sauce, no nam pla.

items.ja: 豚肉のガーリック炒め（ムゥトードカーディアム）
items.en: Pork stir-fried with garlic
items.note: Pork. トード means deep-fried — the pork is fried before saucing, in the same oil as the battered items, and the garlic sauce is soy-and-oyster based.

items.ja: 鶏肉とカシューナッツ炒め（ガイパッマモアンヒマパーン）
items.en: Chicken stir-fried with cashew nuts. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Chicken. This dish is built on oyster sauce and soy sauce, and the chicken is usually flour-dusted and flash-fried first. Wheat.

items.ja: シーフードのスパイシー炒め（パットチャータレー）
items.en: Seafood stir-fried with fresh green peppercorn, krachai and chilli
items.note: Seafood; pad cha is seasoned with fish sauce and oyster sauce. Wheat via the oyster sauce.

items.ja: 海老と春雨炒め（パッウンセンクン）
items.en: Prawns stir-fried with glass noodles
items.note: Mung-bean glass noodles are not wheat, but pad woon sen is sauced with soy and oyster sauce. Prawn and usually egg.

items.ja: タイ風卵焼き（カイジョウ ムゥ/クン）
items.en: Thai omelette with minced pork ¥1,078 or prawn ¥1,210
items.note: Egg and meat, so never vegan. A Thai omelette is egg seasoned with fish sauce and deep-fried in a wok of oil — the fryer oil is shared with battered items here, and rice flour is sometimes added for crispness. Ask.

items.ja: 揚げ生春巻（ポーピアトーサワン）
items.en: Deep-fried spring rolls. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Fried spring-roll pastry is wheat, and it goes through the shared fryer.

items.ja: 海老トースト（カノムパンナートム）
items.en: Fried minced-prawn toast. Marked 定番.
items.note: It is literally bread — sliced wheat loaf spread with prawn paste and deep-fried.

items.en: Deep-fried fish cakes
items.note: Fish. Thai tod man is fish paste bound with red curry paste and egg and normally contains no wheat flour — but it is deep-fried in the same oil as the spring rolls and prawn toast, which is a cross-contamination route on its own. Not recommended for coeliac.

items.ja: 海老のさつま揚げ（トーマンクン）2ヶ
items.en: Deep-fried prawn cakes, two pieces
items.note: Prawn cakes are usually coated in breadcrumbs before frying, and the fryer is shared with wheat items regardless.

items.ja: 海老春巻き（ポーピアンクントース）
items.en: Fried prawn spring rolls
items.note: Wheat spring-roll pastry, shared fryer, prawn.

items.ja: 揚げ春巻き（ポーピアトース）
items.en: Fried vegetable spring rolls
items.note: Wheat pastry — the wrapper alone rules it out for coeliac. The filling is glass noodle and vegetables and may well be vegan, but Thai spring-roll filling often carries minced pork or fish sauce, and the pastry is usually egg-sealed. Ask.

items.ja: 鶏のなんこつ揚げ（エンガイトース）
items.en: Deep-fried chicken cartilage
items.note: Deep-fried chicken is flour- or batter-coated, in a shared fryer.

items.ja: 鶏肉とレモングラス揚げ（ガイタカイ）
items.en: Chicken deep-fried with lemongrass
items.note: Flour coating and shared fryer; the marinade is normally soy- and oyster-sauce based.

items.ja: ソフトシェルのピリ辛揚げ（プーンムプリックァー）
items.en: Soft-shell crab fried with chilli. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Flour-dusted and deep-fried; chilli jam is often soy-seasoned. Crab.

items.ja: 海老のガーリック揚げ（クントーガティーム）
items.en: Prawns deep-fried with garlic
items.note: Deep-fried prawn, shared fryer, soy-and-oyster garlic sauce.

items.ja: 揚げ魚のタイソースかけ（プラーラペック）
items.en: Whole deep-fried fish under a spicy Thai sauce. Chilli level 3. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: The fish is flour-dusted and deep-fried, and rad prik sauce is fish sauce, tamarind, palm sugar and usually oyster and soy sauce.

items.ja: 揚げ魚のイサーンソース（プラトーナムトックム）
items.en: Deep-fried fish with spicy Isaan dressing. Chilli level 3.
items.note: Flour-dusted and deep-fried; Isaan dressing is fish sauce, lime, chilli and toasted rice powder.

items.en: Tom yum goong — hot-and-sour prawn soup with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaf. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Prawn and fish sauce, so not vegan. Tom yum is structurally wheat-free — herbs, chilli, lime, fish sauce — but Thai kitchens routinely add chilli jam (nam prik pao) and seasoning sauce, and no allergen line is published. Ask.

items.ja: 鶏肉のココナッツスープ（トムカーガイ）
items.en: Tom kha gai — chicken in a sour coconut-milk soup with galangal. Chilli level 2. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Chicken and fish sauce. Coconut milk, galangal, lemongrass and lime are wheat-free; the fish sauce and any seasoning sauce are the open question. Ask.

items.ja: シーフードとハーブのクリアトムヤムスープ（トムヤムポーテック）
items.en: Po taek — clear hot-and-sour seafood soup with herbs. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Seafood and fish sauce. Clear (no coconut milk), so fewer added ingredients — but the seasoning sauce question stands. Ask.

items.ja: 豆腐と卵のスープ（ゲーンチュー）
items.en: Gaeng jued — mild clear soup with tofu and egg
items.note: Egg rules out vegan, and gaeng jued's stock is pork bone seasoned with soy sauce and often has minced pork in it. Wheat via the soy.

items.ja: タイ風焼きそば（パッタイ）
items.en: Pad thai — stir-fried flat rice noodles with tamarind, egg, bean sprouts and crushed peanut. Marked 定番.
items.note: The noodle is rice, which is the good news. But pad thai sauce is tamarind, palm sugar and FISH SAUCE, with dried shrimp and egg in the wok — not vegan — and many kitchens add soy or seasoning sauce to it. Ask whether soy sauce goes in.

items.ja: タイスキ焼きそば（スキヘン）
items.en: Suki haeng — 'dry' Thai-suki stir-fried noodles. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Thai suki sauce is a fermented-bean-curd and soy-sauce sauce. Egg and meat or seafood in the wok.

items.ja: 太麺焼きそば（パッシーユー）
items.en: Pad see ew — wide flat rice noodles stir-fried with Chinese broccoli and egg. The shop's own English line reads 'fried wide noodles soy sauce taste'.
items.note: The dish is NAMED after the sauce: ซีอิ๊ว / see ew IS soy sauce, and the shop's own description says so. Thai dark and light soy sauce are wheat-brewed. Egg too. A rice noodle in a wheat sauce is exactly the trap this list exists to catch.

items.ja: 海老入りスパイシー太麺焼きそば（パッキーマオ）
items.en: Drunken noodles — wide rice noodles stir-fried with seafood, holy basil and chilli. Chilli level 3.
items.note: Rice noodle, but the sauce is soy sauce, oyster sauce and fish sauce. Seafood.

items.ja: 豚肉のあんかけ太麺（クイティオラットナームゥ）
items.en: Rad na — wide rice noodles under a thick pork-and-vegetable gravy
items.note: The gravy is fermented soybean sauce and oyster sauce thickened with starch, poured over noodles that were first charred in soy sauce. Pork.

items.ja: タイスキ春雨（スキナム）
items.en: Suki nam — glass noodles in Thai-suki broth. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Mung-bean noodles, but the suki sauce is fermented bean curd and soy sauce, and the broth is meat-based with egg.

items.ja: トムヤムクンライスヌードル（クイッティオトムヤムクン）
items.en: Tom yum goong rice noodles. Chilli level 2.
items.note: Rice noodle in a tom yum broth — prawn and fish sauce (not vegan). Thai noodle-soup broths are usually seasoned with soy or seasoning sauce, so the wheat question is real. Ask.

items.ja: ココナッツカレーヌードル（カオソーイ）
items.en: Khao soi — northern Thai coconut curry noodles. Chilli level 1. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Khao soi is made with EGG NOODLES — wheat — and is topped with a nest of the same noodles deep-fried. The curry also carries soy sauce and the dish comes with chicken. Wheat twice.

items.ja: タイ風チキンライスヌードル（クイッティオガイ）
items.en: Rice noodles with chicken, Thai style
items.note: Rice noodle, chicken broth. The broth's seasoning (soy vs fish sauce) is undocumented. Ask.

items.ja: タイ風ポークライスヌードル（クイッティオトムヤム）
items.en: Rice noodles with pork in a hot-and-sour dressing
items.note: Rice noodle, pork. Seasoning undocumented — ask about soy and seasoning sauce.

items.ja: 煮込みビーフライスヌードル（クイッティオヌァトゥン）
items.en: Rice noodles with slow-stewed beef. Marked 人気 (popular).
items.note: Rice noodle, but Thai stewed-beef broth is braised with dark soy sauce and five-spice. Wheat via the soy. Beef.

items.ja: 鶏肉のバジル炒めご飯目玉焼きのせ（ガパオガイラートカオ）
items.en: Pad kaphrao over rice with a fried egg on top — chicken ¥1,320 / pork ¥1,430 / beef ¥1,650. Chilli level 2. Marked 定番.
items.note: Same kaphrao sauce as the stir-fry: soy sauce and oyster sauce, both wheat routes. Egg and meat.

items.ja: グリーンカレーチャーハン（カオパッキョウワン）
items.en: Green curry fried rice. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Thai fried rice is seasoned with soy sauce; green curry paste normally contains shrimp paste. Wheat and shellfish.

items.ja: トムヤムクンチャーハン（カオパットムヤムクン）
items.en: Tom yum goong fried rice. Chilli level 2. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Fried rice is soy-seasoned; prawn and fish sauce.

items.ja: タイ風海老チャーハン（カオパックン）
items.en: Thai prawn fried rice
items.note: Soy sauce and fish sauce are the standard seasoning for khao phat; egg and prawn.

items.ja: タイ風チキンライス（カオマンガイ）
items.en: Khao man gai — poached chicken with rice cooked in the chicken broth. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: The chicken and rice themselves are wheat-free, but khao man gai is defined by its sauce — fermented soybean paste (taochiao) with ginger, chilli and soy sauce — and the accompanying clear soup is soy-seasoned. Ask for it with no sauce and you are still relying on the rice's cooking liquid. Chicken.

items.ja: 豚肉のチャーハン（カオパッムー）
items.en: Thai pork fried rice
items.note: Soy- and fish-sauce seasoned, with egg and pork.

items.ja: パイナップルチャーハン（カオオッサッパロス）
items.en: Fried rice with prawn served in a hollowed fresh pineapple. Marked 定番.
items.note: Soy-seasoned fried rice with prawn, egg, raisins and cashew.

items.ja: ジャスミンライス（カオフォムマリ）
items.en: Plain steamed jasmine rice
items.note: Steamed jasmine rice and water — no wheat, no animal product, no sauce, and it does not go near the wok or the fryer. It is served on its own plate, so the only realistic risk is a shared serving spoon. This is the survival order in a Thai kitchen for a coeliac.

items.en: Steamed sticky rice, the Isaan staple
items.note: Glutinous rice is rice — the word 'glutinous' describes the texture, NOT gluten, and it contains no wheat protein at all. Steamed in a basket with nothing added; no animal ingredient.

items.ja: グリーンカレー（ゲーン・キョウワーン）
items.en: Green curry with chicken ¥1,045 / pork ¥1,155 / beef ¥1,375. Chilli level 2. Marked 定番.
items.note: Meat and fish sauce, and green curry paste normally contains shrimp paste (kapi) — so not vegan under any substitution short of the kitchen making a separate paste. Thai curry paste and coconut milk are structurally wheat-free, which makes the curries the most promising section here for a wheat-avoider, but the paste brand and any added seasoning sauce are undocumented. Ask.

items.ja: イエローカレー（ゲーン・カリー）
items.en: Yellow curry with chicken ¥1,045 / pork ¥1,155 / beef ¥1,375
items.note: Not a Japanese roux curry — this is a Thai coconut curry, so no wheat flour thickener. Fish sauce and shrimp paste in the base; meat on top. Ask about seasoning sauce.

items.ja: レッドココナッツカレー（ゲーン・パネーン）
items.en: Panang — thick red coconut curry with chicken ¥1,045 or pork ¥1,155. Chilli level 1.
items.note: Coconut cream and red curry paste with peanut; the paste normally carries shrimp paste and the dish is finished with fish sauce. Wheat unlikely but unconfirmed — ask.

items.ja: 揚げ海老のココナッツカレーソース（シューシークン）
items.en: Deep-fried prawns in a choo chee coconut curry sauce
items.note: The prawns are battered and deep-fried before saucing — the coating and the shared fryer are the wheat, not the curry.

items.ja: マッサマンカレー（ゲーン・マッサマン）
items.en: Massaman — mild coconut curry with chicken, potato, peanuts and warm spices. The shop's line: 'No.1 food of the world in CNN'. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Chicken; massaman paste normally contains shrimp paste and the curry is finished with fish sauce and tamarind. No wheat ingredient in the classic recipe, but nothing is published. Ask.

items.ja: 揚げバナナ春巻きのココナッツアイス添え（クルイートードアイティム）
items.en: Fried banana spring roll with coconut ice cream
items.note: Wheat spring-roll pastry through the shared fryer. Coconut ice cream may or may not contain dairy — this one is not documented, so the dessert fails on the pastry regardless.

items.ja: 焼きプリンとココナッツアイス添え（モーケンアイティム）
items.en: Baked Thai custard with coconut ice cream. Marked 人気.
items.note: Khanom mo kaeng is coconut milk, palm sugar, mung-bean or taro and DUCK EGG — never vegan. Traditionally wheat-free (no flour), but the ice cream and any base are undocumented. Ask. Plain baked custard 焼きプリン ¥638.

items.ja: マンゴープリン（マンモプニン）
items.en: Mango pudding
items.note: A set pudding — the setting agent decides everything. GELATIN (animal) and agar (plant) are both common in Japanese-Thai kitchens, and dairy cream is usual in mango pudding. Neither is documented. Ask on both counts. Served with coconut ice cream and sticky rice for ¥1,430.

items.ja: ういろう風ココナッツミルク餅
items.en: Coconut-milk pudding, Thai style — layered and chewy like uiro
items.note: Thai layered coconut sweets are made from rice, tapioca and mung-bean flour with coconut milk, which would be both wheat-free and dairy-free — but the shop names no ingredients and 'uiro-style' could also mean a wheat-flour version. Ask.

items.ja: ココナッツプリン（カノムトゥアイ）
items.en: Khanom tuay — steamed coconut custard in a little cup
items.note: Classic khanom tuay is rice flour, coconut milk and palm sugar — no wheat, no dairy, no egg — which makes it the most likely vegan dessert on the card. Unconfirmed by the shop, so ask.

items.ja: タピオカココナッツミルク（サクー）
items.en: Tapioca pearls in coconut milk. Marked 定番.
items.note: Tapioca is cassava starch and coconut milk is plant — structurally this is both wheat-free and dairy-free. Nothing is published to confirm it, so ask. With coconut ice cream added ¥748.

items.ja: タイ風おしるこ（ブァロイ）
items.en: Bua loi — glutinous rice-flour dumplings in sweet coconut soup. Marked おすすめ.
items.note: Despite the Japanese name おしるこ this is the Thai dessert: dumplings of GLUTINOUS RICE flour (rice, not wheat — the name misleads) in coconut milk. Often served with a poached egg in Thailand, which would break vegan. Ask whether egg is included and whether any wheat flour is in the dough.

tokyo_jikaseimen_no11_asakusa.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Read off a full-resolution photograph of the shop's own ticket machine (食券機) uploaded 2026-08, the newest image on the Tabelog listing and three weeks old at this check, so these are current. DO NOT use the older photos: the same machine shot 2025-12-28 reads ラーメン ¥1,200, 豚ラーメン ¥1,600, 野菜増し ¥80, あぶら増し ¥80, とろり味玉・ラー油 ¥120 — the shop put ¥100 on both bowls and ¥20–30 on the toppings during the first half of 2026. Ten live buttons is the entire ticket menu; the extra toppings are handwritten on a whiteboard above the machine and are paid in CASH to the staff, not bought as a ticket (「スタッフに現金渡し時にお声かけ下さい」). A separate handwritten pink card taped above the machine reads 「ラーメンの食券 ＋ 現金 ¥150」 — it does not say what the ¥150 buys, so it is recorded as an unexplained cash supplement rather than guessed at. Tabelog has no registered menu for this shop and the `website` field is an X/Twitter account, so the machine is the only source. Cash only (カード不可・電子マネー不可・QRコード決済不可), no reservations, counter seats only; 東京都台東区浅草2-22-10, open 11:00–15:00 / 17:30–22:00. Opened 2025-04-05 as the second branch (2号店) of 自家製麺 NO11 in Itabashi; reviewers describe it as 二郎インスパイア系 (Jiro-style).

items.en: The standard bowl — house-made noodles, the shop's only regular ramen
items.note: Ramen noodles are wheat flour and kansui; the tare in any Japanese ramen is soy- or miso-based, both wheat by default. There is no gluten-free option here and no non-noodle dish on the machine. Pork/animal broth — the shop's name 自家製麺 (house-made noodles) is the whole proposition.

items.en: Ramen with an extra load of braised pork
items.note: Wheat noodles; the braised pork itself is simmered in a soy braise. ¥400 over the standard bowl.

items.en: Limited bowl — whatever the shop is running that day
items.note: An unlabelled 'limited' button; the machine does not say what it is on any given day, so nothing about its contents is recorded here. Assume wheat noodles.

items.en: Extra vegetables (bean sprouts and cabbage)
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: Boiled vegetables in themselves are plant-only and wheat-free, but they are cooked in and lifted from the noodle water. In a bowl that is wheat anyway this changes nothing for a coeliac.

items.en: Extra back-fat / seasoned oil
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: Pork fat. Seasoned oils in this style of shop are usually cut with the soy tare.

items.en: Raw egg
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: A shell egg cracked into the bowl — nothing added, so the topping itself carries no wheat. Egg, so not vegan. The bowl it goes into is not gluten-free.

items.ja: とろり味玉・温玉ラー油
items.en: Soft marinated egg, or soft-boiled egg with chilli oil
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: 味玉 is an egg marinated in soy tare — that marinade is the wheat. Egg.

items.en: Ginger tare
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: A 'dare' in a ramen shop is a soy-sauce-based seasoning, i.e. wheat by default. Vegan not stated.

items.en: Bamboo shoot menma with seasoned oil
items.section: 券売機 トッピング Ticket toppings
items.note: Menma is fermented bamboo shoot seasoned with soy; here it also carries the pork-fat oil.

items.en: Beer
items.section: 券売機 ドリンク Ticket drinks
items.note: Barley malt — never gluten-free.

items.ja: まさお（現金トッピング）
items.en: House topping called 'Masao' — paid in cash at the counter
items.section: 現金トッピング Cash-only toppings (whiteboard)
items.note: Handwritten on the whiteboard over the machine; the board gives the name and the price and nothing about what is in it, so no ingredient is recorded here. Ask before ordering.

items.ja: とろろ（現金トッピング）
items.en: Grated mountain yam — cash topping
items.section: 現金トッピング Cash-only toppings (whiteboard)
items.note: Grated yam alone is plant-only and wheat-free, but it is commonly slackened with dashi or tsuyu. Not stated on the board.

items.ja: 紅しょうが（現金トッピング）
items.en: Red pickled ginger — cash topping
items.section: 現金トッピング Cash-only toppings (whiteboard)
items.note: Beni-shoga is ginger, plum vinegar and salt — plant-only, and normally wheat-free, but commercial versions vary and the shop states nothing.

items.ja: 辛あぶら（あぶら増し食券＋現金¥50）
items.en: Spicy oil — buy the あぶら増し ticket and add ¥50 cash
items.section: 現金トッピング Cash-only toppings (whiteboard)
items.note: The board prices this as the あぶら増し ticket plus ¥50 in cash. Chilli oil in a pork shop is normally cut into the pork fat. There is a fifth handwritten column on the same board at ¥50 whose name could not be read confidently from the photograph, so it is not listed here.

tokyo_juwari_soba_sagatani_shi.price_note: Prices approximate — may change. Transcribed from two full-resolution photographs of this branch's own touch-screen ticket machine, taken 2026-03; the 2025-06 shot of the same screen carries identical prices on every overlapping line (かけそば ¥450, もりそば ¥450, 特もり ¥800, ごまだれ ¥550, 二色 ¥650, 釜玉 ¥450, とろろ ¥700, 温玉納豆 ¥750, 天ぷら ¥650, all four sets, all four tempura, all seven toppings, beer ¥350), so these figures have held for at least nine months. The machine rotates two or three seasonal slots: the 2026-03 screen carried 彩り野菜の鴨せいろ／鴨南蛮そば at ¥950 marked 新発売, while the 2025-06 screen instead carried 夏野菜のペペロンそば ¥850 and たぬきそば 冷/温 ¥520 — those three are listed at the bottom of this menu and flagged, because they may or may not be on the machine on the day you visit. The operator's own page for this branch (株式会社フォーユー, 十割蕎麦 さがたに 渋谷東急本店前店) confirms the address 渋谷区道玄坂2-25-7 プラザ道玄坂1F, 21 counter seats, hours 7:00–22:00 Mon–Fri and 10:00–21:00 weekends/holidays, closed 1–3 January, NO credit cards but e-money and QR accepted, and free wakame with any bowl. GLUTEN, IN ONE LINE: the noodles are 十割 (100% buckwheat, stone-milled on the premises) and the shop states nothing about its 打ち粉 dusting flour; the tsuyu is a soba tsuyu, i.e. soy-sauce based; the same small counter kitchen deep-fries tempura to order and serves wheat-roux Japanese curry. Nobody should treat this as a gluten-free soba shop. The operator does publish its dashi: 冷つゆ is 昆布と3種類のブレンド節, 温つゆ 昆布と4種類のブレンド節 — kombu plus blended fish flakes, which settles the vegan question for every bowl served with tsuyu.

items.en: Cold 100% buckwheat soba on a tray with dipping tsuyu — the shop's core product at the price it is famous for
items.note: 十割 (100% buckwheat) noodles milled in-store on a stone mill, so the noodle itself carries no wheat flour — but the shop does not say what its 打ち粉 (board dusting flour) is, and the tsuyu is a soba tsuyu, which is soy-sauce based and therefore wheat by default. The operator's own page gives the cold tsuyu as 昆布と3種類のブレンド節 — kombu plus three blended fish flakes — so it is also not vegan. Ask for no tsuyu and it is still not coeliac-safe because of the dusting flour and the shared boiling water.

items.en: Extra-large cold soba, 500g of noodles
items.note: Double portion of the もりそば. Same wheat and dashi caveats.

items.en: Hot soba in broth
items.note: The hot tsuyu is the shop's 温つゆ, 昆布と4種類のブレンド節 (kombu plus four blended fish flakes) per the operator's own page — bonito-family flakes, so not vegan — and a hot soba broth is built on soy sauce, so wheat. Noodles are 十割 but see the dusting-flour caveat on もりそば.

items.ja: 冷かけそば（ぶっかけそば）
items.en: Chilled soba with cold broth poured over
items.note: Cold tsuyu poured over the noodles — kombu and three fish flakes, on a soy base. Same gluten position as かけそば.

items.en: Cold soba with a sesame dipping sauce (the machine's English: 'Cold soba with sesame sauce')
items.note: A ごまだれ is sesame paste let down with soy sauce and usually dashi — two wheat routes and one animal route on top of the noodle caveats. The shop publishes no recipe for it.

items.en: 'Two-colour' cold soba, 250g
items.note: The machine's English caption on this button reads 'Cold soba with sesame sauce', which is the same caption it prints on ごまだれそば — apparently copied — so what the second 'colour' actually is (a second noodle, or a second dip) is NOT evidenced and is not guessed at here. ¥100 over the plain もり and ¥100 over the ごまだれ. Same noodle and tsuyu caveats.

items.en: Hot soba tossed with raw egg — the machine prints ※つゆなし, no tsuyu
items.note: The one bowl on the machine that is explicitly served WITHOUT tsuyu, which removes the soy-sauce route — but it is still not gluten-free: the noodles are lifted straight from the shop's boiling water and the shop states nothing about its dusting flour, and the same kitchen fries tempura. Raw egg, so not vegan.

items.en: Cold soba topped with grated mountain yam
items.note: Grated yam is plant-only, but it is normally slackened with dashi and the bowl comes with the shop's fish-flake tsuyu. Wheat via the tsuyu.

items.en: Hot soba topped with grated mountain yam
items.note: As the cold version, with the 4-flake hot tsuyu.

items.en: Cold soba with natto, a soft-boiled egg and shredded nori — cold only
items.note: Egg, so not vegan. Natto is served with a soy-sauce tare and the bowl carries the shop's tsuyu — wheat on two counts before you reach the noodles.

items.en: Cold soba topped with vegetable tempura (kakiage)
items.note: Tempura batter is wheat flour, fried in the shop's own fryer — the operator advertises 揚げたて, fried to order on site. This is the dish that makes the whole kitchen a wheat kitchen. Batter usually contains egg as well.

items.en: Hot soba topped with vegetable tempura
items.note: Wheat batter plus the fish-flake hot tsuyu.

items.en: Hot soba in curry broth
items.note: Japanese curry is thickened with a wheat-flour roux and this one is let down with the soy-based hot tsuyu — wheat twice over. The shop does not list what meat is in it, so vegan is 'ask' rather than an assumption, but a shop curry normally carries pork or beef.

items.ja: 彩り野菜の鴨せいろ 冷
items.en: Cold soba with a hot duck-and-vegetable dipping broth — marked 新発売 on the 2026-03 screen
items.section: そば Soba（季節替わり Seasonal slot）
items.note: Duck, so not vegan. A 鴨せいろ dip is a sweetened soy-and-dashi broth — wheat.

items.ja: 彩り野菜の鴨南蛮そば 温
items.romaji: irodori yasai no kamo nanban soba
items.en: Hot soba with duck and vegetables — marked 新発売 on the 2026-03 screen
items.section: そば Soba（季節替わり Seasonal slot）
items.note: Duck and a soy-based hot broth. The most expensive single bowl on the machine.

items.en: Cold soba plus a small rice bowl topped with grilled mackerel flakes — the machine marks it 定番, the house standard
items.note: Grilled mackerel, so not vegan; the rice topping and the soba tsuyu are both soy-seasoned.

items.en: Hot soba plus the mackerel-flake rice bowl
items.note: As above with the hot tsuyu.

items.ja: かきあげ丼セット 冷
items.en: Cold soba plus a small rice bowl topped with vegetable kakiage tempura
items.note: Wheat batter, deep-fried on site, and a 丼 tare is soy sauce. Not viable for either diet.

items.ja: かきあげ丼セット 温
items.en: Hot soba plus the kakiage rice bowl
items.note: As above with the hot tsuyu.

items.en: Cold soba plus a small curry rice
items.note: Wheat-flour curry roux. Meat content not stated on the machine.

items.en: Hot soba plus a small curry rice
items.note: As above with the hot tsuyu.

items.en: Cold soba plus a small chicken-and-egg rice bowl
items.note: Chicken and egg, simmered in a soy-and-dashi broth.

items.en: Hot soba plus the chicken-and-egg rice bowl
items.note: As above with the hot tsuyu.

items.en: Vegetable kakiage tempura, on its own
items.note: Wheat batter; tempura batter normally contains egg. Fried to order in the shop's fryer, which is also why nothing else in this kitchen can be called gluten-free.

items.ja: 磯部香る ちくわ天
items.en: Chikuwa fish-cake tempura with aonori seaweed in the batter
items.note: Wheat batter, and chikuwa itself is a surimi fish cake normally bound with wheat starch. Cheapest thing on the machine after the ¥70 toppings.

items.en: Chicken tempura with aonori in the batter
items.note: Wheat batter, chicken, and a とり天 marinade is normally soy-based.

items.en: Shrimp tempura, one piece
items.note: Wheat batter, shellfish.

items.en: Wakame seaweed — free with any bowl, as much as you like
items.note: The operator's own page states 「お蕎麦と相性抜群のわかめをいつでも無料サービスしています」. Salted rehydrated wakame is seaweed and salt — plant-only and with no gluten grain in it — but it sits in a self-serve tub with shared tongs in a shop that batters and fries tempura a metre away, so it is 'ask' rather than 'gf'.

items.en: Extra spring onion
items.note: Cut raw spring onion and nothing else — no grain and no animal product in the topping itself. It does not make the bowl you put it in gluten-free.

items.en: Shredded dried nori
items.note: Plain 焼海苔 shredded is just seaweed; 味付け海苔 is glazed with soy sauce. The machine does not say which this is, hence 'ask'. Either way it is plant-only.

items.en: A pot of the sesame sauce, as a topping
items.note: Sesame paste thinned with soy sauce, usually with dashi. Wheat via the soy.

items.en: Grated mountain yam
items.note: Grated yam is a vegetable, but soba shops normally loosen it with dashi or tsuyu, both of which would put fish and soy sauce into it. Not stated. The dearest topping on the machine.

items.en: Raw egg
items.note: A shell egg cracked into the bowl, nothing added — the topping carries no wheat. Egg, so not vegan, and the bowl underneath is still not gluten-free.

items.en: Soft-boiled 'onsen' egg
items.note: An onsen egg is egg and hot water, but it is very often supplied in a pack with a soy-sauce tare. The machine says nothing, so 'ask'.

items.en: Fermented soybeans
items.note: The beans themselves are soybeans and bacteria — vegan and wheat-free — but natto is served with its sachet of tare, which is soy sauce (wheat) and commonly carries bonito extract. Whether the shop uses the sachet is not stated.

items.en: Large serving of noodles (upgrade)
items.note: More of the same 十割 noodles; see もりそば for why that is not gluten-free here. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Change to the extra-large serving (i.e. upgrade to 特もり)
items.note: A portion upgrade, not a dish. Vegan status was left blank by an earlier pass and is not established by any source read; recorded as ask.

items.en: Small bowl of plain white rice
items.note: Plain steamed rice with nothing on it — no wheat ingredient, no animal ingredient, and the cheapest safe-ish thing on the machine if you are travelling on rice. It is still 'ask' rather than 'gf' because it is scooped in a kitchen that batters and deep-fries tempura to order and serves a wheat-roux curry; ask for a clean scoop and take nothing poured over it.

items.en: Small rice bowl topped with grilled mackerel flakes
items.note: Grilled mackerel; the flake seasoning is soy-based.

items.en: Small curry rice
items.note: Wheat-flour roux. Meat content not stated.

items.en: Small chicken-and-egg rice bowl
items.note: Chicken and egg simmered in soy and dashi.

items.en: Small rice bowl topped with vegetable kakiage tempura
items.note: Wheat batter and a soy tare.

items.ja: 生ビール（プレミアムモルツ）
items.en: Draught Suntory Premium Malt's
items.note: Barley malt beer — never gluten-free.

items.ja: 生ビール（食事限定・冬季期間価格）※おひとり様2杯まで
items.en: Draught beer at the winter-period price, only with a meal, maximum two glasses per person
items.note: The machine prints 食事限定 / 冬季期間価格 / ※おひとり様2杯まで on this button, so it is conditional and seasonal — it was on the screen in both the 2025-06 and 2026-03 photographs despite saying 冬季. Barley malt, never gluten-free.

items.en: Cold soba with tenkasu (crisp tempura batter bits)

items.note: Photographed on this machine in 2025-06 and gone from the 2026-03 screen, so check before ordering. 天かす is fried wheat batter — the single most wheat-dense topping in a soba shop — and the tsuyu is fish-flake based.

items.en: Hot soba with tenkasu
